title: Assistant Director - Student Accounts
description:
Fisher College, a private institution located in the heart of Boston’s Back Bay, is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and detail-oriented Assistant Director - Student Accounts to join our Bursars'/Finance Team.

Key Responsibilities

The Assistant Director of Student Accounts supports the daily financial operations and student service functions of the Bursar's Office at Fisher College.

Working closely with the Director of Student Accounts & Operations, this position assists with tuition billing, payment processing, refunds, payment plans, collections, account reconciliation, and the resolution of complex student account matters.

The Assistant Director serves as a key resource for students, families, and College departments, provides operational guidance to the Office Assistant without direct supervisory responsibility, and assists the Director in maintaining efficient departmental operations.

The position requires strong financial and analytical skills, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for operational improvement.

Student Account Management & Services

  • Support daily student account activities, including tuition billing, payments, refunds, account adjustments, and payment plans.
  • Respond to student and family inquiries, research billing discrepancies, and independently resolve complex account issues.
  • Review student accounts for accuracy and communicate financial obligations, payment options, and College policies.
  • Collaborate with Financial Aid, Registrar, Admissions, and other departments to resolve account concerns, referring exceptional matters to the Director as appropriate.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Monitor outstanding and delinquent student balances, coordinate collection outreach, and follow up on overdue payments.
  • Work with students and families to establish payment arrangements and monitor payment plan activity.
  • Coordinate financial holds, registration clearance, and collection referrals in accordance with College policies.
  • Review accounts receivable activity and recommend opportunities to improve collections and reduce outstanding balances.

Financial Operations & Reconciliation

  • Assist with daily cash balancing, deposit reconciliation, and maintaining accurate financial records.
  • Research and resolve financial discrepancies involving student accounts, payments, financial aid, and refunds.
  • Prepare financial reports and support monthly, semester-end, and fiscal year-end reconciliation activities.
  • Process and review student account transactions, including payments, refunds, adjustments, and reconciliations.

Departmental Operations & Process Improvement

  • Assist the Director in coordinating daily Bursar's Office operations, departmental workflows, and recurring billing and registration activities.
  • Support the Director in monitoring departmental deadlines and maintaining accurate procedures, records, and training materials.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies, recommend practical improvements, and assist with implementing new systems and procedures.
  • Provide operational support in the Director's absence within established policies and delegated authority.

Staff Support & Coordination

  • Provide day-to-day operational guidance to the Office Assistant regarding student account procedures and departmental workflows.
  • Assist with employee training and onboarding.
  • Serve as a resource for complex student account questions and assist with coordinating daily office priorities and coverage.
  • Support the Director in promoting accuracy, consistency, and effective communication within the office.

title: Carrier Relations Specialist
description:
About United Road

United Road is the largest finished vehicle logistics company in North America. We move new and used vehicles for OEMs, dealerships, auctions, and fleet operators across the continent. We do it through company drivers, owner-operators, and thousands of third-party carriers in our Haully network.

Our pillars are simple: Expertise, Partnership, and being Ever-Present for our customers and carriers. This role lives the Partnership pillar every day.

Carrier Relations Specialist

You are the voice carriers hear when they call United Road, and the first person they meet when they join us. You recruit third-party carriers into the Haully network, onboard them, and stay with them through their journey: setup, credentials, customer requirements, and the everyday questions that come up once they are hauling for us.

Most of your day is on the phone, inbound and outbound. If you like talking to people, solving problems on the spot, and being the person carriers trust to follow through, you will do well here.

What your day looks like

  • Carrier recruiting and onboarding (core):
  • Make outbound calls to recruit and qualify third-party carriers into the Haully network.
  • Onboard new carriers from first contact through their first loads, including setup and credentials.
  • Guide carriers through every step of their journey with us, and answer their questions along the way.
  • Help carriers understand each customer's individual requirements so they can haul with confidence.
  • Provide website and platform support, including help with log-in credentials.

Carrier service and relationships:

  • Answer inbound calls and voicemails from carriers, resolve their questions and complaints, and follow through until they are handled.
  • Make outbound calls to investigate internal complaints about transport delays, communication, or professionalism.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with third-party carrier capacity to support Logistics operations and the terminal network, and meet customer demand.
  • Monitor and report carrier performance and metrics, and review them with carriers on a regular basis.
  • Monitor third-party carriers' Central Dispatch ratings and discuss with them as needed.
  • Help facilitate the Carrier Awards.

Compliance and administration:

  • Make sure carrier insurance renewal certificates and cancellations are received on time and updated in the tracking system.
  • Maintain and update carrier profile information regularly.
  • Track and report fuel surcharges for third-party carriers.
  • Provide weekly active carrier lists and specifications to dispatch teams.
  • Process mail daily, with a focus on certificate updates and cancellations.
  • Answer incoming calls and voicemails to the Compliance Department.
  • Back up other Compliance and Carrier Relations team members during time off.
  • Support projects as needed by the Carrier Relations Manager.

What we are looking for

  • Comfortable on the phone. You will spend much of your day on inbound and outbound calls, and you like it.
  • A service mentality. You want to help carriers, and you follow through until the job is done.
  • Strong communicator. Clear written and verbal communication, plus real listening skills.
  • Attention to detail. You catch the small things and have the discipline to follow a process.
  • Organized. Strong time management and the ability to juggle and prioritize work.
  • Relationship builder. You can build trust and turn a contact into a long-term relationship.
  • Technically capable. Microsoft Office, Salesforce or another CRM, and general web tools. Basic data analysis.
  • Self-starter. You can run independently and work well as part of a team.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred not required, but a plus.
  • At least 2 years in customer service. Hospitality or any service industry counts. Transportation, logistics, or carrier recruitment experience is a bonus, but we will train the right person.
  • A team player. You have worked on a team and know how to pull your weight and back up your teammates.
  • Eager to grow. You want to learn the finished vehicle logistics (FVL) business and build a career here.
  • Intermediate computer skills. Comfortable with Microsoft Office and office systems and procedures.

Location: Plymouth, MI (on-site)

United Road is proud to offer our full-time employees best-in-class benefits designed to support your health, well-being, and financial security. From comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage to generous retirement savings options and paid time off, we provide a benefits package that goes beyond the basics. We also offer unique perks like a zero-dollar-out-of-paycheck medical plan, telehealth, wellness discounts, and employee assistance resources, ensuring that our team is fully supported both at work and in life. These benefits reflect our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent while helping employees thrive every day.

Health & Wellness

  • BCBS PPO Medical with Telehealth
  • Delta Dental
  • NVA Vision
  • Company Paid Life and AD&D
  • Supplemental Life
  • Dependent Life
  • Short-Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • New Vehicle Supplier Discounts

Financial Benefits

  • 401(k) with Company Match

Work-Life Balance

  • PTO Program (Vacation, Sick, Personal, Jury, Bereavement)
  • 6 Paid Holidays

title: LIFE SKILLS PROFESSIONAL
description:
❤️ Empower Recovery. Build Life Skills. Change Lives.

Life Skills Professional

📍 WOMANSPACE EMPOWER Program- 6671 Germantown Avenue, Philadelphia, PA 19119
🕒 Full-Time 8am-4pm
💵 DailyPay Available

Looking for More Than Just a Job?

At Resources for Human Development (RHD), we believe recovery is about more than overcoming challenges. It is about building confidence, developing life skills, and creating opportunities for a brighter future.

We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Life Skills Professional to join the WOMANSPACE EMPOWER in Philadelphia. This role provides direct support to individuals in recovery by helping them develop coping skills, daily living skills, recovery supports, and personal goals that promote independence and long-term success.

If you are passionate about supporting individuals on their recovery journey and want to make a meaningful impact every day, we encourage you to apply.

About WOMANSPACE EMPOWER

WOMANSPACE EMPOWER is a recovery-focused residential behavioral health program that provides individuals with a supportive environment where they can strengthen their recovery, develop independent living skills, and work toward personal wellness goals.

Through person-centered and recovery-oriented services, the program helps participants build confidence, increase self-sufficiency, and achieve meaningful outcomes in their lives and communities.

Why Join Our Team?

💰 Competitive Pay & Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation
  • DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness Programs
  • Company-Paid Training
  • Career Advancement Opportunities

🎓 Career Growth & Development

  • Paid Training Programs
  • Professional Development Opportunities
  • Recovery-Oriented Care Training
  • Leadership Development Opportunities
  • Opportunities for Advancement
  • Experience Working Within Behavioral Health Services

❤️ Meaningful Work That Matters

  • Support Individuals on Their Recovery Journey
  • Help Participants Build Daily Living Skills
  • Promote Independence and Wellness
  • Encourage Personal Growth and Recovery
  • Build Meaningful Relationships
  • Join a Mission-Driven Organization

What You'll Do

As a Life Skills Professional, you will:

  • Provide direct support and coaching to program participants throughout your shift.
  • Assist individuals in developing life skills, recovery supports, coping strategies, and daily living skills.
  • Facilitate and document psychoeducational and recovery-focused groups.
  • Support participants in achieving goals identified within their Recovery Support Plans (RSPs).
  • Intervene in crisis situations and complete required incident documentation.
  • Review program documentation for accuracy and completeness, including observation checks, medication administration records, and shift notes.
  • Support participants with maintaining household responsibilities and independent living skills.
  • Enter required census, demographic, intake, and billing information into agency systems.
  • Assess participant strengths, skills, and learning styles to support individualized growth and development.
  • Develop and review Recovery Support Plan goals with participants every 60 days.
  • Collaborate with community agencies and service providers to ensure coordinated services.
  • Promote a recovery-oriented, trauma-informed, and person-centered environment.
  • Report maintenance, safety, and program concerns as needed.
  • Complete additional duties as assigned.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate
✔ Recovery-Oriented
✔ Dependable
✔ Patient
✔ Team-Oriented
✔ Service-Focused
✔ Professional
✔ Committed to Helping Others Succeed

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Minimum of two years of experience in the social service field.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with individuals experiencing behavioral health challenges.
  • Ability to complete documentation accurately and timely.
  • Ability to support a recovery-oriented and trauma-informed environment.

Preferred

  • Certified Psychiatric Rehabilitation Practitioner (CPRP).
  • Certified Peer Specialist (CPS).
  • WRAP (Wellness Recovery Action Plan) Training.
  • Experience working in residential behavioral health or recovery-focused programs.

Schedule

  • Non-Exempt Position
  • Flexible scheduling may be required
  • Evening, weekend, and holiday coverage may be required based on program needs

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, reach, stoop, and climb stairs.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to drive and transport participants if required.
  • Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.

🌟 Apply Today

Some jobs pay the bills.

Some jobs build careers.

This job changes lives.

If you're passionate about recovery, personal growth, and helping individuals achieve greater independence and wellness, we encourage you to apply today.

Join WOMANSPACE EMPOWER and become part of a team that helps individuals build hope, confidence, and a stronger future.

About Our Organization

Resources for Human Development (RHD) is a national human services organization dedicated to supporting individuals through innovative, person-centered programs that promote dignity, recovery, independence, and community inclusion.

title: Associate Vice President for Research Integrity and Compliance
description:
Reporting to the Vice President for Research, the Associate Vice President for Research Integrity and Compliance (AP- RIC) serves as a key member of the Office of the Vice President for Research (OVPR) leadership team. The Associate Vice President for Research Integrity and Compliance is responsible for GW’s overall strategy to ensure research compliance, foster a culture of research integrity, advocate and advance research security matters, and promote the responsible conduct of research at the Institution both domestically and internationally.

Responsibilities of this position include the following:

- Leadership and oversight of University research compliance, regulatory committees, and education programs including but not limited to:
  - Human Research Protection Program (HRPP)
  - Institutional Review Board (IRB)
  - Institutional Animal Care & Use Committee (IACUC)
  - Animal Program & Facilities (indirect reporting relationship)
  - Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC)
  - Radiation and Laser Safety
  - Dual Use Research of Concern (DURC)
  - Stem Cell Research Oversight (SCRO)
  - Export Control
  - Foreign Influence and International Collaborations in Research
  - Research Conflict of Interest
  - Regulatory Affairs and Strategy
  - Research Compliance and Quality Assurance
  - Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
- Serves as the University’s Research Integrity Officer.
- Serves as the main designee of the Institutional Official for Research.
- Coordinates the development and implementation of programs and operational strategies for research compliance issues in areas of oversight to ensure policies and procedures facilitate quality research and minimize the risk of non-compliance.
- Coordinates research compliance and risk management activities with key stakeholders across GW, particularly with the Office of Sponsored Projects, to develop a streamlined experience for researchers, staff, and students.
- Coordinates the development and enforcement of research compliance-related policies, processes, training and guidance materials, monitoring compliance for the University’s domestic and international research activities.
- Leads Office of Research Integrity and Compliance teams, including management of direct reports, staff development, and establishing and maintaining a service-minded culture.
- Works with the Provost’s Office and academic leadership to ensure appropriate compliance related education and training resources are available to those engaged in the conduct of research at GW. Jointly oversees and ensures support for academic and research Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR) requirements, including supervision of related employees (i.e. the Deputy Research Integrity Officer).
- Leads the University’s Responsible Conduct of Research program including oversight of management of allegations of research misconduct, reporting to applicable external agencies, and support for training and educating researchers on the responsible conduct of research. Fosters a culture that promotes the responsible conduct of research. Oversees development and implementation of outreach programs.
- Leads and oversees quality assurance and post-approval monitoring programs to include the conduct of routine, directed, and for-cause audits and post-approval monitoring across all areas of research subject to regulatory committee approvals, and support for corrective and preventive action plans.
- Oversees Research Security Program, including compliance with NSPM-33, CHIPS Act and other laws and regulations related to areas of export controls, foreign influence vulnerabilities, international collaborations and international travel, cyber and information security, and facility clearance and physical security.
- Oversees the development of research onboarding, education and training curricula in support of all areas of research oversight to promote world-class, quality research and maximize compliance with mandated training obligations.
- Mediates and seeks resolutions, consistent with University policies, state, federal, and other funding agency requirements, related to non-compliance, research misconduct and scholarship disputes. Maintains GW policies and procedures related to the same.
- In collaboration with the Vice President for Research, develops and implements short- and long- term strategies to enhance the operational aspects of research compliance and integrity. Advises the Vice President for Research and other senior leaders throughout the University, faculty and others on matters pertaining to research compliance and ethics.
- May represent the Vice President for Research and the unit at various internal/external meetings, committees and/or conferences; may serve on various University committees for the purpose of advising on matters related to assigned functional area; and works cross-functionally with University leadership on a variety of divisional matters.
- Collaborates closely with other key University offices: Office of General Counsel, Environmental Health and Safety, Information Technology, Office of Ethics, Compliance and Risk, Risk Management, Faculty Affairs, University Faculty Senate, leadership within the schools, etc.
- Collaborates with University Information Technology in developing, implementing, and managing compliance-related research administration electronic systems.
- Oversees maintenance of accreditation of the Human Research Protection Program (AAHRPP) and Institutional Animal Care and Use Program (AAALAC).
- Engages and demonstrates leadership at a national level on research compliance topics.
- Builds and maintains a positive and collaborative relationship with regulatory agencies.

Performs other work-related duties as assigned. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

title: Research Engineer, Level II-IV
description:
## Department

[National High Magnetic Field Laboratory](https://nationalmaglab.org/) - DC Field User Facility

## Responsibilities

- Responsible for selecting and applying standard engineering techniques and procedures for the construction, repair and maintenance of highly specialized scientific research equipment in collaboration with scientists and users. Involvement from conception of idea, design and construction of new apparatus. Assist users in carrying out experiments in a variety of superconducting and resistive magnet cells.
- Assist with policy development for overall user program. Maintain technical knowledge and expertise of all specialized equipment in order to identify short and long range instrumentation needs. Assist with the development and direction of the user program.
- Analyze problems with research equipment. Arrange with vendors or NHMFL shops for repair of instruments. Keep records of equipment shipped and received
- Order, receive, and distribute supplies, instrumentation and tools. Assist with providing software and data acquisition support to users and other NHMFL project teams.
- Other duties as assigned, including participation in Open House and other outreach activities. Serve on committees that promote safety, operational efficiency, and a productive working environment.

## Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and three years of experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and seven years of experience. (Note: post-high school education can substitute for experience at the equivalent rate.)

Candidates with an additional three years of related experience will be considered for levels Ill - VI. Each level requires an additional three years of related experience.

One of the nation's elite research universities, Florida State University preserves, expands, and disseminates knowledge in the sciences, technology, arts, humanities, and professions, while embracing a philosophy of learning strongly rooted in the traditions of the liberal arts and critical thinking. At FSU, there’s the excitement of being part of a vibrant academic and professional community, surrounded by people whose ideas are shaping tomorrow’s news!

[Learn more about Florida State University and our campuses](https://hr.fsu.edu/working-fsu/prospective-employees).

Use our [FSU Total Compensation Calculato](https://hr.fsu.edu/total-rewards/compensation-services/total-compensation-calculator) rto calculate Total Compensation options based on potential salary, benefits and retirement contributions, earned leave, and other employment-related perks.

## How To Apply

If qualified and interested in a specific job opening as advertised, (jobs.fsu.edu). If you are a current FSU employee, apply through myFSU Self Service.

Applicants are required to complete the online application with all applicable information. Applications must include all work history up to ten years, and education details even if attaching a resume.

## Considerations

This is an A&P position.

This position requires successful completion of a [criminal history background check](https://policies.vpfa.fsu.edu/policies-and-procedures/faculty-staff/employment-recruitment#B11).

## Equal Employment Opportunity

title: WIC BF PEER COUNSELOR
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

As a breastfeeding peer counselor in the WIC Program, offer pregnant and lactating women information, encouragement and support needed for a successful breastfeeding experience.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Provide breastfeeding information and promote breastfeeding to pregnant women.
  2. Address infant feeding concerns of pregnant mothers.
  3. Correct misinformation which may prevent a pregnant woman from considering breastfeeding.
  4. Teach classes on the advantages of breastfeeding.
  5. Prepare breastfeeding motivational and/or informational bulletin boards in the WIC clinic.
  6. Counsel and support lactating mothers and manage breastfeeding problems as they occur.
  7. Identify breastfeeding experiences that are not normal and make an immediate, appropriate referral to the Lactation Consultant.
  8. Contact pregnant and postpartum women by phone to encourage and support breastfeeding.
  9. Keep accurate records of counseling sessions.
  10. Provide support and information to lactating mothers who are returning to work/school in an effort to encourage them to continue breastfeeding.
  11. Issue breast pumps and record breast pump issuance as directed by WIC policy.
  12. Adhere to proper procedure for pump retrieval, use phone, texting, email and letter by mail.
  13. Teach lactating mothers how to clean and assemble breast pumps and train them in the techniques of expression and storage of human milk.
  14. Performs other related duties incidental to the work described herein as may be assigned or delegated.
  15. Conduct weekly breast pump inventory.
  16. Maintain confidentiality of client records.
  17. Comply with all company policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.
  18. Performs all other duties as assigned by management.

EDUCATION/LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION QUALIFICATIONS:

REQUIRED:

High school diploma or GED

title: Receiving Clerk
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Receive, unload, and process deliveries and account for incoming freight based on invoice and receiving reports. Stage merchandise by department, mark appropriately for placement in facility, and deliver merchandise to appropriate department. Verify and track received inventory and complete inventory reports and logs. Reconcile shipping invoices and receiving reports to ensure count accuracy. Receive, store, ship, and deliver incoming and outgoing department packages and mail. Secure the receiving room and its contents, ensuring safekeeping of packages. Follow all national, state, and local hazardous material shipping guidelines and regulations. Ship all out-going mail and packages. Verify quantity and condition of packages upon receipt prior to delivery to guest. Communicate with guest regarding received packages. Maintain accurate tracking system on all shipping and receiving transactions, including receiving guest signatures for received packages. Communicate with proper management regarding any loss or damage with packages.

Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Address guests' service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner. Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

title: General Mngr Trainee West Salem Burger K
description:
General Manager

Reports To:

District Manager

Job Location:

Field

FLSA Status Type:

Non-Exempt - Hourly

Direct Reports:

Assistant Managers

Shift Leaders

Team Members

Position Overview

The General Manager role at Ambrosia QSR is full-time position responsible for overseeing all restaurant operations, including guest service, employee engagement, and profitability. Key responsibilities include ensuring the consistent execution of guest service standards, food safety protocols, quality control, and adherence to company policies. This full-time position requires open availability, strong accountability, leadership, and the ability to mentor the team. During peak hours, the General Manager plays an active role in leading the team to ensure smooth operations and exceptional guest experiences. They are accountable for setting clear goals, establishing timelines, and ensuring the team meets performance targets.

Job Responsibilities

Team

  • Provide training and development opportunities for the management team and staff. Conduct performance reviews according to the company’s scheduled timeline
  • Recruit, train, and develop restaurant management and staff, following training plans and company systems to meet goals within the designated timeframe
  • Schedule regular team and manager meetings to communicate effectively, ensuring all staff are informed of any company or policy changes
  • Enforce company policies, including compliance with laws and local regulations, such as work breaks, timekeeping, and minor management responsibilities. Maintain accurate employee records and submit them on time as required
  • Immediately report any complaints or employee behavior that violates company policy to the assigned district manager, and resolve issues promptly
  • Foster a safe, inclusive work environment that does not tolerate harassment, discrimination, or retaliation (report any incidents to the assigned District Manager and Human Resources)

Guests

  • Greet every guest warmly and promptly, creating a welcoming atmosphere
  • Strive to provide exceptional an experience for every guest on every visit, addressing any issues with positivity and sound judgment
  • Regularly walk through the restaurant to check on guests, inquire about their dining experience, and ensure the building’s interior and exterior is inviting and safe
  • Stay informed about the local market trends and community needs to make guest-centric decisions

Operations

  • Oversee food safety and other safety protocols, ensuring all required postings are clearly visible and properly displayed
  • Implement marketing plans and ensure the restaurant staff is trained and ready for promotions, following company guidelines
  • Use a headset to monitor team interactions with guests, offering praise, coaching, or redirection as needed
  • Address basic equipment maintenance issues as they arise
  • Manage labor costs by creating accurate sales projections, writing balanced schedules, and ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time
  • Ensure daily food safety compliance and operational standards are consistently met by the team
  • Communicate with the District Manager, Director of Operations, and Restaurant Support Center as needed, ensuring emails and requests are addressed timely
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Profitability

  • Ensure all food is prepared fresh to order, following company recipes, and accurately record all items in the POS system
  • Oversee all sales transactions within the POS system and ensure proper use of inventory tracking systems. Implement measures to address inventory concerns when needed
  • Manage controllable expenses, making sure to place inventory orders while maintaining cost standards
  • Establish and maintain positive relationships with vendors and internal support teams
  • Oversee proper use of equipment, small wares, and products. Confirm all equipment is cleaned regularly and preventive maintenance is performed to ensure safety and functionality. Address minor equipment issues promptly and report any non-functional equipment to Operations Support immediately
  • Supervise staff to ensure compliance with all cash handling, banking policies, and procedures
  • Verify that all asset protection systems are in use and functioning properly
  • Follow company policies and procedures for cash handling to ensure accuracy, security, and compliance with financial guidelines

Education and Work Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Serv Safe training & certificate
  • Prior experience with a POS System
  • 2 years of hands-on food or retail management experience

Qualifications and Skills

  • Authorized to work in the United States
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Able to successfully pass a background check, including criminal history.
  • Ensure compliance with all required training as mandated by local, state, and federal laws, as well as company policies, to maintain operational and regulatory standards
  • Maintain a working cell phone and effectively communicate via text, phone calls and emails
  • Intermediate or higher proficiency in Microsoft 365
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively
  • A responsible team player, demonstrating punctuality, proper attire, and respect for others
  • Experience in a fast-paced office environment with shifting priorities is a plus
  • Engage in hands-on leadership with a strong focus on growth and development of people
  • Be able to work with, coach, and develop a diverse group of people from different backgrounds and with varying strengths
  • Demonstrate the core Cultural Foundations of Energy, Engagement, Empathy, and Execution through all interactions with both internal and external stakeholders

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

The work environment is fast-paced, high-energy, and dynamic, requiring the ability to multitask and remain organized under pressure. You will be working in a team-oriented atmosphere, collaborating with other members of the team to ensure smooth restaurant operations. This role involves frequent interaction with customers, creating a welcoming and efficient dining experience. The restaurant environment includes both indoor and outdoor areas, and you may be required to stand, walk, and move throughout the shift. Safety and cleanliness are top priorities, and all staff members are expected to follow health and safety protocols. Flexibility in working hours, including nights, weekends, and some holidays, is required.

REQUIRED Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):

Boots (oil/heat resistant for fryer filter)

Gloves (oil/heat resistant for fryer filter)

Apron (oil/heat resistant for fryer filter)

Face Shield (oil/heat resistant for fryer filter)

Heat Resistant Gloves (oil/heat resistant for fryer filter)

Cut Resistant Gloves (slicing equipment)

Oven Mitts (heat resistant for ovens)

Broiler Gloves (heat resistant for ovens)

Benefits

  • Medical – United Healthcare and Kaiser
  • Voluntary Life Insurance, Dental and Vision – United Healthcare
  • Company Paid Life Insurance – United Healthcare
    Flexible Spending Accounts – Medical, Limited Dental & Vision, Dependent Day Care
  • Matching 401(K) and Roth retirement savings plans – age 20 or above
  • Vacation Time – 10 days a year
  • Floating Holidays – 3 days a year
  • Sick Time – 1 hour for every 30 hours worked, no waiting period
  • Direct Deposit
  • Monthly Bonus
    Quarterly Bonus
  • Flexible Scheduling
    Growth Opportunities

Nasze inkluzywne i globalne zespoły wspólnie zwyciężają każdego dnia. Jesteśmy dumni, że mamy najlepsze umysły w branży, od których możesz się uczyć, rozwijając swoją karierę. Globalpayerzy myślą jak klient, działają jak właściciele i wygrywają jako jeden zespół. Są ciekawi i innowacyjni — zawsze szukają lepszych sposobów na osiąganie rezultatów. Wspieramy się nawzajem w podejmowaniu decyzji, a nasza pasja napędza doskonałość we wszystkim, co robimy.

title: Accounts Receivables Specialist
description:
Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist Summary

The Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist is responsible for managing customer accounts, reducing outstanding receivables, and ensuring timely payment of invoices. This role focuses on proactive communication, resolving billing issues, maintaining accurate records, and supporting overall cash-flow objectives. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, persistent, customer-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.


Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist Duties & Responsibilities:

Collections & Follow-Up

  • Contact customers via phone, email, and portal messaging to secure payment on outstanding invoices.
  • Monitor aging reports and prioritize accounts based on risk level and days past due.
  • Document all collection activities in the accounting system.
  • Negotiate payment arrangements (Upon approval from Corporate Controller) and follow up to ensure commitments are met.
  • Identify delinquent accounts and recommend escalation when necessary.


Billing & Dispute Resolution

  • Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, short payments, and disputes.
  • Collaborate with sales, customer service, and operations to obtain missing information or approvals.
  • Reissue corrected invoices or supporting documentation as needed.


Cash Application Support

  • Coordinate with the cash application team to ensure payments are applied correctly.
  • Follow up on unapplied or misapplied payments.

Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare weekly/monthly reports on overdue accounts, collection activities, and risk trends.
  • Provide account status updates to management and participate in A/R review meetings.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Maintain professional, positive relationships with customers while enforcing credit and payment terms.
  • Educate customers on billing procedures, online payment methods, and credit policies.


Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist Education & Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate or bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or Business preferred.
  • 1–3 years of experience in A/R, collections, or related accounting function.

Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist Skills

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to handle difficult conversations professionally.
  • Proficiency in accounting systems (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.).
  • Intermediate Excel skills (VLOOKUP, filtering, basic formulas).
  • Strong time management and organizational abilities.

Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to manage a high volume of calls and emails.
  • Occasional overtime during month-end close or peak periods.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice. This job description is not a contract and may be adjusted or modified as deemed appropriate at the employer’s sole discretion to meet the company’s changing needs.

title: AP Specialist
description:
SUMMARY

The primary purpose of this position is to perform crucial job duties that ensure vendors get paid for services and products rendered. The Accounts Payable Specialist provides both administrative and financial support by processing, verifying and reconciling Invoices. The incumbent monitors accounts payable (AP) to confirm all recurring bills are received a entered in the correct period and company. Advantix maintains approximately 45 separate payable entities and each invoice must be charged to the correct entity and general ledger (GL) accounts. The incumbent monitors workflow and period cut off procedures. Reconciliation of irregularities is required.

All activities must support Advantix’s strategic goals and objectives and produce results that accomplish the goals of the overall organization.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Primary areas of responsibility and tasks that may typically be expected include but are not limited to:

Accounts Payable

  • Manages accounts payable using accounting software and other programs.
  • Reconciles vendor statements to in house recorded.
  • Handles accounts payable for separate entities and vendors.
  • Tracks and reconciles intercompany transactions.
  • Analyzes workflow processes.
  • Establishes and maintains relationships with new and existing vendors.
  • Ensures bills are paid in a timely and accurate manner while adhering to departmental procedures.
  • Processes due invoices for payments.
  • Processes transactions and performing accounting duties such as account maintenance, recording entries and reconciling vendor accounts.
  • Sorts payables into batches and complete data entry daily.
  • Provides printed checks to appropriate directors for signatures.
  • Mails authorized checks or distributes checks with necessary attachments.
  • Files copies of authorized checks with appropriate invoices.
  • Maintains responsibility for assisting in Tenant accounting and bank reconciliations as needed.
  • Maintains responsibility for additional check processing requirements as needed.
  • Maintains filing up to date for review purposes.

Annual 1099 Reporting

  • Reconciles reporting files with historical records.
  • Identifies and corrects 1099 vendor information.
  • Prepares electronic 1099 reporting file for submission to the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).
  • Submits 1099 and 1096 forms in a timely manner.
  • Maintains and updates W-9 and insurance documentation.
  • Manages State and Federal Grants including grant job costing, budgeting and analysis
  • Performs other related duties as assigned and/or required.

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

Problem Solving: Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem solving situations; uses reason even when dealing with sensitive topics and/or irate customers.

Job Knowledge: Exhibits requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the position effectively. Demonstrates knowledge of policies, procedures, goals, objectives, operational entities, requirements, and activities as they apply to the assigned organizational entity. Uses appropriate judgment & decision making in accordance with level of responsibility.

Customer Service: Understands that all employees have external and/or internal customers that they provide services and information to; honors all the organization’s commitments to customers/residents by providing helpful, courteous, accessible, responsive and knowledgeable customer service.

Interpersonal Skills: Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; maintains confidentiality; listens to others without interrupting; establishes rapport when working with others.

Teamwork: Cooperates with others to accomplish common goals; works with employees within and across his/her department to achieve shared goals; treats others with dignity and respect and maintains friendly demeanor; values the contributions of others.

Results Orientation: Consistently delivers required agency results; sets and achieves achievable, consistently complies with quality standards and meets deadlines; maintains focus on organizational goals.

Accountability: Accepts full responsibility for self and contribution as a team member; displays honesty and truthfulness; confronts problems quickly; displays a strong commitment to organizational success and inspires others to commit to goals; demonstrates a commitment to delivering on his/her public duty and presenting oneself as a credible representative of the organization to maintain the public’s trust.

Professionalism: Approaches others in a tactful manner; reacts well under pressure; treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; accepts responsibility for own actions.

title: Turkish Speaking Customer Advisor (Hybrid)
description:
• Job Title: Turkish-Speaking Travel Support Specialist / Customer Experience Advisor
  • Location: Lisbon, Portugal (Hybrid structure: 2–3 days remote per week)
  • Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent
  • Sector: Global E-Commerce Travel, Lodging & Itinerary Services
  • Work Schedule: Monday – Friday (Rotating morning schedules: 07:00–16:00 & 08:00–17:00) — Guaranteed Weekends Off!
  • Languages Required: Native or advanced fluent Turkish (C1/C2) & Professional English (B2)

Legal Requirement & Work Authorization

  • Mandatory Eligibility: All applicants must hold valid EU/EFTA Citizenship or an active Portuguese Residency Card prior to applying.
  • Note: Visa sponsorship is strictly unavailable, and applications from candidates without current legal permission to work in Portugal cannot be processed.

About the Role

Are you a skilled communicator with a dedicated service mindset and an interest in the global tourism sector? Take the next step in your career with a leading European customer experience and operational partner located in Lisbon!

In this dynamic position, you will serve as a frontline ambassador for a major international digital travel brand. You will act as a main point of contact for Turkish-speaking users and commercial hospitality partners, delivering top-tier service across flight, hotel, and vacation rental bookings via phone, email, and live ticketing channels.

Key Responsibilities & Core Accountabilities

  • Customer Care Excellence: Deliver professional, efficient, and empathetic resolution to Turkish-speaking travelers regarding trip modifications, itinerary adjustments, cancellations, and travel logistics.
  • Reservation & Billing Management: Handle booking changes, refund requests, payment verification, and special accommodation preferences (e.g., accessibility needs or dietary requirements) with precision.
  • B2B Partner Coordination: Liaison directly with hotels, resort operators, car rental providers, and airline representatives to address guest inquiries and smooth out operational disruptions quickly.
  • Proactive Problem Resolution: De-escalate complex traveler concerns and booking discrepancies, focusing on achieving immediate, single-contact resolutions.
  • Systems Administration: Accurately record, track, and manage customer records, interaction histories, and support requests using modern CRM platforms.
  • Performance Quality: Consistently meet key metrics such as First Contact Resolution (FCR), Average Handle Time (AHT), and Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores while maintaining full adherence to brand protocols.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Essential Criteria

  • Work Authorization: Valid EU/EFTA Citizenship OR an active Portuguese Residency Card (Required).
  • Language Proficiency: Native or advanced fluent (C1/C2 level) proficiency in spoken and written Turkish, complemented by a solid professional command (B2 level) of English for internal training modules, system navigation, and team communications.
  • Professional Experience: Prior background in call center support, retail, customer care, or tourism is an asset, but not mandatory (a fully paid training program is provided).
  • Technical Skills: Strong computer literacy, including the ability to navigate multiple web platforms, CRM software, and databases concurrently while maintaining fast, accurate typing skills.

Interpersonal Strengths

  • High emotional intelligence, active listening capabilities, adaptable problem-solving skills, and composure during peak volume periods.

Compensation & Benefits Options

To support both resident candidates and those moving to Lisbon, two distinct compensation options are available:

  • Option 1: Standard Salary Package

    • Base Remuneration: €1,436.16 Gross / month (payable over 12 months).
    • Additional Benefits: Monthly performance-based bonus scheme, daily meal allowance allocation, and standard medical and local benefit coverage.
  • Option 2: Relocation & Accommodation Package

    • Base Remuneration: €1,138.66 Gross / month (payable over 12 months).
    • Company Accommodation: Private room in a fully furnished shared company apartment (all utility expenses covered: electricity, water, internet, and gas).
    • Travel Reimbursement: Full initial flight expense reimbursement following successful completion of the probation period.
    • Arrival Assistance: Dedicated relocation support team to assist with airport pickup and city integration.

Work Arrangement & Shift Structure

  • Hybrid Work Model: Enjoy a balanced work environment featuring 2 to 3 days of work-from-home flexibility per week upon finishing initial on-site training and nesting.
  • Fixed Business Hours: Standard shifts operate strictly Monday through Friday on a rotating schedule:

    • Shift 1: 07:00 – 16:00
    • Shift 2: 08:00 – 17:00
  • Work-Life Balance: No weekend shifts required! Saturdays and Sundays are completely reserved for leisure and exploring Lisbon.

Why Join Us in Lisbon?

  • Fully Paid Training: Comprehensive onboarding covering tools, customer care strategy, and system navigation.
  • Internal Mobility: Over 80% of leadership, training, and operational support positions are promoted directly from within the company.
  • Multicultural Environment: Collaborate alongside international colleagues in a vibrant, diverse atmosphere in one of Europe's safest capitals.

title: Director, Package Development
description:
HOURGLASS COSMETICS — Director, Package Development (Hybrid Role)

Connected by creativity and driven by purpose. Hourglass Cosmetics is a vegan and cruelty-free beauty brand, redefining luxury cosmetics with high-performance products, innovative formulas, and award-winning franchises. Recognized by Forbes, Fast Company and Time Magazine as one of the most inventive beauty companies, Hourglass leads the industry with its breakthrough products and its commitment to animal welfare. Founded in 2004, Hourglass is globally available in 32 markets and over 4,600 doors including Sephora, Ulta, Neiman Marcus, Selfridges, Space NK and more. Hourglass became part of the Unilever Prestige division in 2017. Discover more about the Hourglass brand story and mission on our website hourglasscosmetics.com.

The Director of Package Development works collaboratively with the Founder, Product Development, and related cross-functional teams, to develop and execute new color and skincare products from concept through launch. This leadership role manages and supports a team with a solution-oriented and strategic approach to ensure projects meet the intended design, quality, cost, risk, sustainability, functionality, and manufacturability objectives.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Conduct comprehensive feasibility assessments for new packaging concepts and components, evaluating functionality, manufacturability, cost, tooling requirements, development timelines, technical risks, and global consistency.
  • Identify, communicate, and resolve project timeline challenges; provide regular milestone updates and proactively escalate technical or scheduling risks to ensure successful project execution.
  • Provide engineering technical support, expertise, and guidance to the Packaging team.
  • Drive risk mitigation throughout development and validation by partnering cross-functionally to conduct risk assessments and implement corrective actions that support project success.
  • Source and develop both stock and custom primary and secondary packaging solutions, creating detailed supplier briefs and technical specifications.
  • Review, approve, and manage technical drawings, component submissions, and packaging specifications to ensure components meet quality, fit, form function, and aesthetic expectations.
  • Create, maintain, and manage Bill of Materials and review/approve fill & assembly instructions.
  • Manage artwork development processes, including initiating artwork requests and reviewing files for technical accuracy, regulatory compliance, and production readiness prior to release.
  • Lead packaging validation and testing activities, including compatibility, transit, drop, and performance testing; analyze results and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Develop packaging test protocols, validation plans, and cross-functional Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support quality and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers and production teams to ensure packaging feasibility, optimize manufacturing efficiency, and support line trials, pilot runs, and commercial production.
  • Research and identify innovative packaging formats, sustainable materials, decoration techniques, and emerging technologies that align with brand objectives and business goals.
  • Liaises with Quality and Operations determine root cause, resolution and finding alternatives as needed.
  • Coordinate and manage the development of photo-ready, retailer, and internal meeting comps for NPD.
  • Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships through regular engagement, business reviews, and attendance at industry trade shows and supplier meetings.
  • Manage packaging activities across all stages of product development, including concept evaluation, sourcing, development, sampling, validation, commercialization, line support, and resourcing initiatives.

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF:

  • You are a SELF-STARTER: You thrive in autonomy and are motivated to take initiative.
  • You are DETAIL ORIENTED: You appreciate the importance of having detailed and precise information with an impeccable eye for aesthetics.
  • You are a strong COMMUNICATOR and COLLABORATOR: You work and communicate effectively with all members of the organization, from individual contributors to executive team.
  • You are extremely ORGANIZED: You are not overwhelmed by the thought of tackling multiple tasks.
  • You are RESULTS-ORIENTED. You have a bias for action. When problems arise, you reliably produce responses and thoughtful solutions.
  • You are METICULOUS and ACCURATE. You take pride in being careful and precise with your work.
  • You are STRATEGIC and ADAPTIVE: You can efficiently anticipate, identify and articulate problems in real time. Extremely agile.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum 10 years of package development experience.
  • BA/BS in Packaging Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent.
  • Solid knowledge of the prestige/luxury beauty market and a passion for products, packaging and how they work together.
  • Understanding of packaging sustainability and global compliance.
  • Technical competency in analysis of geometric objects in 2 and 3 dimensions including understanding of clearances, fit and finish of packaging components and subcomponents.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of materials used in the construction and manufacturing of primary, secondary and tertiary packaging including knowledge of decorating techniques and materials used on primary, secondary and tertiary packaging.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of test methods used to validate component/package performance.
  • Highly adaptable and flexible to change with the ability to quickly switch gears.
  • Exceptional project management experience.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and tasks with precision and detail.
  • Solid problem-solving skills, analytical skills and business acumen.
  • Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong working knowledge of MS Suite products (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and project management platforms.
  • Must be able to work from Corporate Office at least 60% of the time.

The expected base salary range for this position is $135,000 to $145,000 per year. The exact base salary is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, and budget.

This position is also eligible for participation in the company discretionary bonus plan, based on personal performance and company results.

In addition to base salary, Hourglass Cosmetics offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees, including medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, disability insurance, retirement savings plans and company match, paid family leave, education-related programs, paid holidays, discretionary vacation time, and more.

Hourglass is an organization committed to diversity and inclusion to drive its business results and to create a better future every day for its diverse employees, global consumers, partners and communities. If you are an individual with a disability and need accommodation in order to apply for a job listing, please contact us at 310-392-7799 or careers@hourglasscosmetics.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

title: Muon Tomography Engineer (Hybrid)
description:
Join a pioneering deep-tech team developing safe, rapid, and accurate active muon imaging solutions tailored for industrial quality assessment, security and customs inspection, and advanced medical diagnostics. Operating at the intersection of advanced particle physics, cutting-edge AI, and next-generation particle detectors, our platform delivers high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making.

In this role, you will be the driving force behind how raw particle track data is transformed into precise 3D density reconstructions. Working in a fast-paced environment with access to multi-GeV beamlines and collaborative partnerships across the energy, defense, aerospace, and security industries, your work will directly empower critical pass/fail quality control assessments for high-stakes metallic and ceramic components—ranging from rocket engines and gas turbines to nuclear and industrial systems.

Key Responsibilities & Core Tasks

  • End-to-End Reconstruction Ownership: Take complete ownership of the pipeline that converts raw particle tracks into accurate 3D density maps, directly influencing the mission-critical decisions made by industrial clients.
  • Algorithm Evolution: Advance reconstruction methodologies smoothly from foundational approaches like Point of Closest Approach (POCA) and Algebraic Scattering Reconstruction (ASR) to sophisticated likelihood-optimization frameworks.
  • Grid Performance Optimization: Explore and deploy adaptive or multi-resolution reconstruction grids designed to strategically trade off resolution against memory constraints and processing speed.
  • Advanced Uncertainty Modeling: Leverage the narrow energy bandwidth of the muon beam to compute rigorous, per-track error weights rather than relying on generalized global constants.
  • Multi-Modal Data Fusion: Integrate external priors—such as high-resolution optical scans, computer vision data, and digital object geometry—directly into reconstructions as hard constraints to tighten the solution space.
  • High-Flux Track Statistics: Develop robust statistical and algorithmic solutions to resolve track pile-up and hit-ambiguity issues in particle detectors operating under high-flux conditions where multiple particles register simultaneously.
  • Production Software Delivery: Move far beyond temporary research scripts. Package and maintain standalone software tools featuring fixed, reliable input/output formats designed for long-term operational use.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Partner closely with internal cross-functional teams and external research institutions across the globe to refine imaging capabilities and field-test solutions.

Requirements & Candidate Profile

  • Educational Background: A Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) degree in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or a closely related technical field is strictly required.
  • Professional Experience: Minimum post-doctoral experience required, with a strong preference for candidates bringing a few years of dedicated post-doctoral research background.
  • Technical & Scientific Must-Haves:

    • Deep expertise in tomographic reconstruction, specifically having implemented POCA, ASR, or equivalent scattering-tomography algorithms, with the capability to pivot to likelihood optimization when point-based limits are reached.
    • Proven experience with numerical performance optimization, including building adaptive or multi-resolution grids.
    • Demonstrated skill in tracking-detector physics, including resolving particle hit ambiguities and high-flux pile-up.
    • Hands-on experience with multi-modal data fusion and uncertainty modeling at the individual track level.
    • Production software engineering capabilities, successfully transitioning research code into maintained, robust software packages.
  • Language Proficiency: At least full professional proficiency in English (C1 level); proficiency in German or Estonian is considered a valuable bonus.
  • Logistics & Availability:

    • Available to start work by January 2027 or, at the latest, February 2027.
    • Open to occasional international travel to collaborate at various global research facilities and partner labs.
    • Willing to work in a hybrid setup based out of our primary research hub.

Personality & Working Culture

  • Ownership & Drive: You prefer shipping complete, reliable tools over throwing together quick research scripts. You embrace accountability and treat outside parameters as definitive constraints.
  • Curiosity & Rigor: When assumptions break, you find it fascinating rather than frustrating. You insist on validating and testing your models against real physical objects.
  • Collaborative Spirit: You thrive in a compact, autonomous "skunkworks" team where titles matter less than clear thinking. You are comfortable debating ideas vigorously ("disagree together, commit together") and executing as a unified team.

Compensation & Benefits Package

  • Equity Program: A substantial employee equity package offering a meaningful stake in the company's financial and market success.
  • Impact & Ownership: Complete autonomy within a fast-moving, high-impact team taking cutting-edge research prototypes to market-ready products within rapid iteration cycles.
  • Access & Infrastructure: Direct engagement with multi-GeV beamlines and elite research networks spanning aerospace, energy, and deep tech.
  • Relocation Support: Comprehensive international relocation assistance and full visa sponsorship support to ensure a seamless transition to Hamburg.

title: Clinical Applications Coordinator
description:
Connect healthcare, technology, and better patient care!

Do you enjoy solving technical challenges, improving processes, and helping people get the most out of technology? Quinault Community Health (QCH) and Quinault Wellness Center (QWC) are seeking a Clinical Applications Coordinator to support and optimize the electronic health record (EHR) systems and clinical applications that keep our healthcare services running effectively.

You will serve as one of two operational resources for clinical applications, working closely with medical providers, dental services, behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, pharmacy, radiology, administrative teams, and IT. Your work will help ensure our systems support accurate documentation, efficient workflows, regulatory compliance, and quality patient care across both organizations.

What you'll do:

  • Train and support employees: Provide hands-on guidance to providers and staff, assist with new employee system setup and orientation, and develop practical user guides, training materials, workflow documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  • Support reporting and data integrity: Help develop, maintain, and troubleshoot EHR reports, dashboards, and data tools while identifying documentation or workflow issues that may affect data accuracy and reporting.
  • Coordinate with IT and vendors: Serve as a liaison between departments, IT, EHR vendors, and technology partners to communicate system needs, track issues, coordinate resolutions, and document changes and enhancements.
  • Promote security and compliance: Support appropriate system access, role-based permissions, privacy safeguards, and compliance with applicable healthcare regulations and organizational policies, including HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2, as applicable.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact behind the scenes by helping healthcare professionals spend less time navigating technology challenges and more time focused on the people they serve.

title: Muon Beamline Engineer (Hybrid)
description:
Join an innovative deep-tech pioneer dedicated to developing safe, rapid, and precise active muon imaging systems for high-stakes industrial quality assessment, security, customs inspection, and advanced medical diagnostics. Our platform merges advanced laser-plasma-accelerator-driven muon sources, next-generation particle detectors, and sophisticated AI to deliver high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making.

Operating out of major research hubs in Germany and Estonia, our work directly empowers quality and safety assessments for critical metallic and ceramic components—ranging from aerospace hardware like rocket engines and gas turbines to large-scale nuclear and industrial installations. In this role, you will take total ownership of how the muon beam travels from the converter to the scanned object, steering the complete lifecycle of capture, transport, and shielding design.

Key Responsibilities & Core Tasks

  • End-to-End Beam Transport Ownership: Own the complete pathway of the muon beam from converter to target, managing capture efficiency, transport dynamics, and comprehensive radiation shielding.
  • Beamline & Geometry Evolution: Design efficient muon capture and controllable transport systems, building upon current operational setups (such as the 35° tunnel bend) while scaling and extending designs toward future laser-plasma-accelerator (LPA) based muon sources.
  • Holistic Shielding & Background Optimization: Construct integrated models for beamline shielding, treating the critical trade-off between background noise reduction and muon signal preservation as the core design constraint, while leveraging fast-model approximations to bypass full simulation runs on every iteration.
  • Fast Simulation Development: Build and benchmark agile simulation tools for rapid beamline optimization, applying them seamlessly across current experimental beamlines and next-generation architectures.
  • Optics & Magnet Engineering: Optimize collection and transport optics for polychromatic beams. Evaluate permanent magnets versus electromagnets based on achievable field strength, demagnetization risks (such as neutron-induced effects), cost, supply chain reliability, and tunability—and directly lead the subsequent procurement process.
  • Infrastructure Resilience: Ensure long-term radiation resilience across all beamline components and magnetic infrastructure.

Requirements & Candidate Profile

  • Educational Background: A Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) in accelerator physics, particle physics, nuclear engineering, or a closely related technical field is strictly required.
  • Professional Experience: Minimum post-doctoral experience required, with a strong preference for candidates bringing several years of dedicated post-doctoral research background.
  • Technical Must-Haves:

    • Complete fluency in GEANT4 with proven particle transport simulation and validation experience.
    • Deep expertise in shielding and background physics (accounting for gammas, positrons/electrons, and neutrons).
    • Hands-on beam optics experience tailored for polychromatic beams and constrained spatial geometries.
    • Demonstrated skill in developing fast simulation models.
    • Sound understanding of radiation-aware magnet engineering and mitigation of magnetic degradation.
  • Language Proficiency: At least full professional proficiency in English; ability in German or Estonian is considered a valuable plus.
  • Logistics & Availability:

    • Available to start in January 2027 or, at the latest, February 2027.
    • Open to occasional international travel to visit and collaborate at global research facilities and partner installations.
    • Position is structured as a hybrid role based out of our primary research headquarters (approx. 1 day/week home office; fully remote is not available).

Personality & Working Culture

  • Proactive & Analytical: You comfortably challenge design assumptions, push back on constraints when physics demands it, and build models validated against realistic beam conditions.
  • Ownership Mindset: You treat hardware procurement and supply-chain realities as natural extensions of the engineering design process.
  • Fast-Paced Adaptability: You thrive in an agile "build to learn" environment, favoring rapid prototyping, hands-on experimentation, and tight iteration loops over slow, overly polished processes.

Compensation & Benefits Package

  • Equity Program: A substantial start-up employee equity package providing a meaningful stake in the company's long-term success.
  • Benefits & Relocation: Attractive supplementary benefits alongside a comprehensive international relocation package and visa support.

title: Camps Director & Sports Program Assistant
description:
About Chelsea Piers

Chelsea Piers Connecticut brings together sports, fitness, recreation and events in a dynamic destination in Stamford. We create experiences that help people of all ages build skills, connect with others and enjoy active lives.

Our team makes those experiences possible. We value teamwork, hospitality, accountability and a commitment to making someone’s day. Joining Chelsea Piers means working alongside passionate colleagues across a diverse business, with opportunities to contribute ideas, grow professionally and make a meaningful impact on our community.

The Opportunity

The Camps Director & Sports Program Assistant is responsible for coordinating, growing, and ensuring successful execution of the Summer Camps, School Break Camps, Kids Unleashed, and other youth and family-based programs and business lines. They will oversee the operational execution of all of these programs at Chelsea Piers Connecticut and report directly to the Vice President of Sports. This role is a relationship and business management-driven position, with camps and youth programs serving as major entry points for new families into the Chelsea Piers ecosystem.

This role requires a highly organized, growth-driven leader who can oversee curriculum development and delivery, develop staff, host training sessions, strategically monetize underutilized business areas for youth and family programs, and deliver best-in-class guest experiences while ensuring strong operational execution across camps, specialty sport- and enrichment-related youth programs.

Schedule: Full-Time, in-person, 40 hours per week. Schedule may vary based on events and business needs, and may include weekday evenings and weekends.

Compensation: $55,000 - $60,000

Key Responsibilities

Camp and Programs Development & Growth:

  • Coordinate and grow summer camps, school break camps & sport/specialty youth programs business across Chelsea Piers Connecticut
  • Own the financial performance of camps and assigned youth programs, including revenue growth, profitability, labor management, and enrollment targets.
  • Support sports directors in building and retaining a committed team of counselors and coaches for summer camps, school break camps, Kids Unleashed, enrichment programs and partnerships, and specialty youth programs
  • Ability to identify trends and develop and execute new programming for toddlers up to teens from end to end.
  • Ability to build out and deliver staff training that motivates a team and creates a camp culture across all programs
  • Coordinates schedules with sports directors
  • Must be comfortable having conversations with parents regarding their child’s physical, social & emotional progress or experiences in programming
  • Identify and launch new revenue-generating youth and family programs that maximize facility utilization during traditionally underutilized days and times, in collaboration with VP of Sports
  • Must be the OEC expert for camps when it comes to timelines, deadlines, regulations, and ensuring compliance
  • Build relationships with schools, camps, PTOs, community organizations, and families to generate new business opportunities
  • Develop strategies to convert camp participants and families into year-round Chelsea Piers customers through sports programs, family memberships, events, and other experiences
  • Work closely with Marketing

Operations & Execution

  • Oversee operational execution of Summer Camps, School Break Camp and specialty youth programming
  • Ensure staffing, scheduling, training, guest experience, safety, communication, and operational consistency across all programs. Build scalable systems and SOPs to support operational excellence and long-term growth
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sports, Operations, Marketing, Fitness, and Guest Services to ensure best-in-class execution and customer experience
  • Oversee recruitment, training and onboarding for all camp staff, in collaboration with sports directors and People Operations
  • Manage the camps-ct@chelseapiers.com mailbox and ensure timely communication
  • Support the Vice President of Sports on strategic initiatives, new programming opportunities, special events, and cross-departmental projects that advance the overall Sports business

Measures of Success

title: Senior Data Scientist / Data & AI Specialist
description:
Jesteśmy wiodącą agencją retail media w Polsce.

Zmieniamy sposób w jaki marki sprzedające w offline’ie zarządzają swoimi działaniami online’owymi, dokładając brakującą cegiełkę między akcjami w online, a rezultatami w offline. Pomagamy naszym klientom skutecznie wspierać sprzedaż stacjonarną narzędziami digital oraz pozyskiwać unikalną wiedzę nt. konkurencji i ścieżek konsumentów.

Sercem jest technologia umożliwiająca zbieranie danych o zachowaniach w świecie rzeczywistym 8 milionów konsumentów oraz ciągły monitoring ruchu w 200 tysiącach lokalizacji w Polsce. Przetwarzane każdego miesiąca miliardy zdarzeń otwierają przed nami ogrom możliwości.

Dzięki współpracy z wiodącymi retailerami w zakresie dostępu do danych transakcyjnych (m.in. Żabka, Lewiatan), realizujemy efektywne kampanie retail media z pomiarem sprzedaży w sklepach stacjonarnych.

Notujemy dynamiczny wzrost (śr. ok. 65% rocznie), a w 2024 roku dołączyliśmy do Grupy Blix. Budujemy naszą kulturę na odpowiedzialności, otwartej komunikacji i wspólnym rozwiązywaniu problemów. W stajesz się częścią mocnego zespołu, a nie zasobem ludzkim.

O roli:


Szukamy osoby, która pomoże nam jeszcze lepiej wykorzystywać dane w rozwoju naszych produktów i technologii.
Każdego miesiąca przetwarzamy miliardy zdarzeń generowanych przez ok. 12 milionów użytkowników, a także pracujemy z danymi transakcyjnymi naszych partnerów, w tym Żabki i Lewiatana. Realizujemy również projekty analityczne dla klientów, takie jak analizy ścieżek i przepływów klientów sklepów stacjonarnych.
Na tym stanowisku będziesz mieć duży wpływ na sposób, w jaki wykorzystujemy dane, rozwijamy rozwiązania analityczne oraz wdrażamy narzędzia AI wspierające nasze wewnętrzne procesy i obsługę klientów.
Będziesz współpracować z 5-osobowym zespołem Data & Tech, w którym pracują analitycy, data scientist, developer i DevOps. W zależności od doświadczenia będziesz również wspierać pozostałe osoby w zespole merytorycznie i pomagać w podejmowaniu decyzji technologicznych.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • rozwój rozwiązań analitycznych i data science wykorzystywanych w naszych produktach i projektach dla klientów,

  • udział w planowaniu kierunku rozwoju technologii i sposobów wykorzystania gromadzonych danych,

  • rozwój i wdrażanie praktycznych zastosowań AI oraz automatyzacji,

  • wsparcie merytoryczne i mentoring osób pracujących w obszarze danych,

  • współpraca z zespołami Sales Operations i Campaign Operations nad automatyzacją procesów,

  • zwiększanie dostępności danych i możliwości ich wykorzystania przez pozostałe zespoły,

  • przekładanie problemów biznesowych na rozwiązania analityczne i technologiczne.

Nasze oczekiwania:

  • odpowiedzialność i samodzielność w realizacji powierzonych tematów,

  • dobra znajomość Pythona i SQL,

  • doświadczenie w analizie danych, data science, data engineering lub pokrewnym obszarze — najlepiej min. 2-3 lata,

  • praktyczna znajomość narzędzi AI i zainteresowanie ich wykorzystaniem w codziennej pracy,

  • doświadczenie w pracy z większymi zbiorami danych,

  • znajomość podstaw statystyki i machine learningu,

  • pragmatyczne podejście i skupienie na tworzeniu rozwiązań, które faktycznie działają i rozwiązują problemy biznesowe,

  • umiejętność komunikowania zagadnień technicznych osobom nietechnicznym,

  • chęć dzielenia się wiedzą i współpracy z innymi osobami w zespole.

Nie wymagamy wcześniejszego doświadczenia w formalnym zarządzaniu zespołem. Ważniejsze jest dla nas to, że potrafisz samodzielnie prowadzić tematy, dzielić się wiedzą i pomagać innym w podejmowaniu dobrych decyzji.

Mile widziane:

  • doświadczenie z dużymi zbiorami danych lub systemami przetwarzającymi dane w dużej skali,

  • doświadczenie w AdTech, MarTech lub pracy z danymi geoprzestrzennymi,

  • znajomość zagadnień związanych z atrybucją, testami inkrementalności, data clean rooms lub pomiarem efektywności mediowej,

  • doświadczenie w tworzeniu rozwiązań wykorzystujących LLM-y lub narzędzia AI,

  • doświadczenie w środowisku startupowym lub produktowym.

Nie oczekujemy, że będziesz mieć doświadczenie we wszystkich powyższych obszarach. Jeśli część z nich jest Ci bliska, a pozostałych chcesz się nauczyć — również chętnie z Tobą porozmawiamy.

Co oferujemy:

  • realny wpływ na kształt produktów i kierunek rozwoju firmy,

  • możliwość pracy przy danych i problemach w dużej skali,

  • dużą samodzielność i przestrzeń do proponowania własnych rozwiązań,

  • nietrywialne problemy oraz zaangażowany zespół, który pomoże Ci je rozwiązywać,

  • pracę zdalną z możliwością pracy w biurze w Warszawie i Poznaniu,

  • kartę Multisport i prywatną opiekę medyczną,

  • lekcje angielskiego
