  • Infrastructure Automation: Streamline environment provisioning across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and T Cloud Public utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), drastically cutting down manual setup overhead and reducing human errors.
  • Container Administration: Maintain, run, and continuously optimize containerized platforms built on Docker and OKD/OpenShift, alongside the mission-critical applications operating on top of them.
  • Cloud Performance Optimization: Ensure high availability, peak performance, fault tolerance, and comprehensive security standards across varied hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

Requirements & Qualifications

Mandatory Prerequisites:

  • Cloud Computing Background: Solid, applied familiarity and architectural understanding working with at least one major cloud infrastructure provider (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or T Cloud Public).
  • Container Technology Skills: Proven, hands-on experience running Kubernetes-based container systems (with a strong focus on OKD/OpenShift) alongside standard Docker containerization.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Practical command of Terraform to successfully manage declarative infrastructure deployments.
  • DevOps Toolchain & Experience: A minimum of 3 years of career history within a specialized platform infrastructure, cloud engineering, or DevOps position, reinforced by strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Git version control workflows.
  • Language Requirements: Professional fluency in German (minimum C1 standard) is mandatory for routine team syncs, technical documentation, internal communications, and all interview phases.

Desirable Prerequisites:

What We Provide

  • Compensation Package: Competitive starting salary reaching up to €70,000 gross per year, augmented by supplementary compensation for taking on-call duties.
  • Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Engage daily with advanced container and multi-cloud ecosystems (including AWS, Azure, T Cloud Public, Kubernetes/OKD, and Terraform).
  • Work-Life Harmony: A stable hybrid working model (2 days in the office / 3 days remote), adaptable work hours, and an inclusive, family- and pet-friendly office culture.

title: Special Effects Artist (Assassin's Creed Invictus)
description:
#### Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in video games, with teams spread across the four corners of the world who create original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin's Creed to Rainbow Six, including Just Dance and many more. We believe that diversity of perspectives drives progress for both players and teams. If you are passionate about innovation and want to push the limits of entertainment, join our adventure and help us create the unknown!

#### Job Description

As a **special effects artist** at **Ubisoft Montréal**, you will create striking visual moments that enrich gameplay and enhance the experience of players. You will help bring immersive worlds to life through **environmental effects** such as smoke, fire, explosions, snow, water and other **real-time effects**.

In this role, you will combine creativity and technical skills to design, integrate and optimize high-quality **special effects** directly within the **game engine**. You will collaborate with several teams to ensure a consistent, performant and visually powerful experience.

**What you will do**

- Collaborate with the **creative direction** to understand the project vision and define priorities for **special effects**
- Create environmental effects using **particle systems** and original **textures**
- Work with the **programming** teams to assess needs and support the development of **tools**
- Design **special effects** that respect technical constraints while maintaining strong artistic impact
- Integrate special effects into the **game engine** and ensure their performance in **real time**
- Adjust and optimize effects based on the results of **playtesting**
- Fix technical issues related to **special effects** when necessary
- Adapt effects based on feedback from collaborating teams
- Take community feedback into account after launch when relevant

#### Qualifications

**What you bring to the team**

- Demonstrate skills in creating **real-time special effects** for **video games** or interactive media
- Master **3D production pipelines** including modeling, texturing, lighting or image processing
- Know **2D art** tools, compositing software, **3D** software and **game engines**
- Understand **artistic fundamentals** such as lighting, composition, proportion and color theory
- Apply basic **vector mathematics** to special effects
- Receive feedback and adjust your work accordingly
- Collaborate effectively with different teams
- Communicate clearly and pay attention to detail
- Use **procedural tools** or graphics rendering programs such as **shaders** is an asset

**What to send us**

- Your resume highlighting your relevant skills and experience
- A portfolio showcasing your best special effects along with an overview of your creative process

title: Assistant Manager
description:
FourSite Property Management, operating under Bach Team, aims to provide quality service and housing to our customers, offer valuable work experience for employees, and earn a fair profit while maintaining a competitive, professional image.


Carrington Square is seeking a full-time Assistant Manager to join our team! This position plays a key leadership role in the daily operations and overall success of the community, working closely with the Property Manager to drive leasing performance, resident satisfaction, and financial results.


The Assistant Manager will be responsible for leading and supporting the leasing team, overseeing resident engagement and retention efforts, managing lease renewals, and maintaining strong resident relationships. Additional responsibilities include monitoring delinquency, managing in-house collection efforts, assisting with marketing initiatives, and ensuring a positive resident experience throughout the leasing and residency lifecycle.

title: Network Engineer
description:

  • Computer Systems Officer Level 4

About us

The NSW Police Force (NSWPF) is one of the largest police forces in the western world, with more than 20,000 employees, including more than 4,000 administrative employees who support the sworn officers that provide a range of law and order services 24 hours a day, seven days a week to the socially, geographically and culturally diverse community of NSW.

About the role

We have an opportunity for a Network Engineer to be part of our Network and Security Platform Services, Technology and Communication Services Command . The Network Engineer implements and maintains security controls that protect NSW Police’s systems and data, ensuring secure design, risk mitigation, and compliance. By embedding security into technology platforms, it helps safeguard sensitive information and supports the organisation’s mission to uphold public safety and trust.

The Network and Security Platform Services Directorate is responsible for the connectivity and security that underpins policing across NSW Police Force (NSWPF). The team manages and maintains enterprise network and security services supporting over 550 NSWPF remote sites, as well as key data centres and core technology platforms.

The Directorate enables secure and reliable connection of users and devices to NSWPF systems, ensures the delivery of data across the statewide network, and maintains strong control of network boundaries, security and data flows. This includes responsibility for NSWPF telecommunication services and the interoperability and connectivity between internal applications, external services and connected devices.

The Network Platform is seeking to recruit a Network Engineers (CSO4) to join the Network and Security Platform Services Directorate to work alongside Senior Network Engineers and technical leaders to provide hands-on engineering, operational and delivery support across enterprise network and voice platforms. The CSO4 roles play an important role in day-to-day operations, service improvement initiatives, technical delivery while contributing to the ongoing uplift and maturity of the network platform. This is an excellent opportunity for engineers looking to deepen their enterprise experience within a large, complex environment.

As a Network Platform Engineer (CSO4), you will:

  • Provide technical support and engineering services within LAN/WAN (Core Network) environments with a primary focus on F5 load balancing infrastructure
  • Support the operation, maintenance, optimisation, and lifecycle management of network and F5 infrastructure to ensure service reliability and performance
  • Manage F5 platform patching, software upgrades, and iRules development, ensuring compliance with operational and security standards
  • Investigate and resolve incidents, contribute to problem management activities, and implement changes in accordance with established IT service management processes
  • Drive continuous service improvement through automation, monitoring enhancements, documentation, and the development of technical standards and operating procedures
  • Work collaboratively with senior engineers, service delivery teams, projects, other government agencies and vendors
  • Provide operational support across Cisco SD-WAN, Cisco Catalyst Center, wireless, routing and switching, and Cisco ACI environments
  • Contribute to the adoption of automation and modern network management practices to improve operational efficiency and service outcomes
  • Build technical capability and progress towards senior specialist roles

These roles are well suited to engineers with strong technical foundations who are seeking to grow their skills at enterprise scale. You will assist with the implementation and support of IP network solutions, including troubleshooting, network access, monitoring, control, evaluation and documentation, while ensuring cyber security requirements are consistently met. The role also require participation in rotational on-call support arrangements. Strong communication skills are essential, as you will work with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders and be expected to tailor technical advice and instructions to suit different audiences.

Positions report directly to their relevant Platform Lead and may also support capacity driven activities across the Network Platform.

To be considered for this role, applicants must demonstrate:

  • Proven experience working with enterprise network or voice technologies
  • Exposure to large, complex operational environments
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to work effectively as part of a team while managing competing priorities
  • A desire to learn, grow and develop specialist depth
  • Minimum CCNA level certification in a relevant networking and technology discipline
  • Equivalent vendor certifications or demonstrable equivalent experience may be considered where appropriate

IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS FOR APPLICANTS: You will be required to complete a Baseline Vetting Clearance, please note you may be required to upgrade your clearance to NV1 in the future.

View the relevant role description for more information on this role (e.g. essential requirements, key accountabilities, key challenges and capabilities required for the role)

What we can offer you

At NSWPF our people have access to a range of benefits that help balance life at work and at home. Some of the benefits available when you join the NSWPF include:

  • competitive salary;
  • flexible work options;
  • opportunity to purchase leave;
  • annual leave loading;
  • corporate wellbeing programs including seminars and the Fitness Passport;
  • free annual influenza vaccination;
  • salary packaging options via superannuation contributions or a novated vehicle lease;
  • convenient location for public transport and to shops etc; and

How to Apply

Applications can only be submitted electronically via the I Work for NSW website.

To be considered for this role, attach a cover letter (2 pages maximum) and an up-to-date resume that clearly details your skills & experience as relevant to this role.

Please do not attach copies of qualifications, certificates or documentation (other than what has been requested) - you can bring these if called for interview.

Please address each of the following Target Questions (500 word per question) in the text boxes provided in the online application or attach as a separate document.

Target Question 1:

In your response, please outline: • The type of network or platform environment you supported • Your role and responsibilities within the team • How you worked with others (e.g. senior engineers, service teams or vendors) • An example of how you contributed to maintaining or improving service reliability or performance

Your application must stand on its own merits, and the completeness and relevance of your application will determine if you proceed through to the selection process.

To be eligible to apply for this role, you must meet one of the following statuses:

Prior to commencement, the successful candidate will be required to undergo a rigorous National Police (criminal history) Check and obtain and maintain a Security Clearance as determined by the NSW Police Force.

title: MDS Coordinator
description:
About Us:

Our primary mission is to improve the lives of the residents we serve. Our values are driven by and encompass Dignity, Integrity, Service, Compassion, and Respect.

About the Role:

The MDS Coordinator plays a crucial role in ensuring that the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments are completed accurately and timely, which is essential for compliance and reimbursement in the healthcare sector. This position involves collaborating with various departments to gather necessary patient information and ensure that it is documented correctly in the MDS system. The MDS Coordinator will also be responsible for training staff on MDS processes and updates, ensuring that the team is well-informed and compliant with regulations. Additionally, this role requires the analysis of MDS data to identify trends and areas for improvement in patient care. Ultimately, the MDS Coordinator contributes to the overall quality of care provided to residents and supports the organization's mission of delivering exceptional healthcare services.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
  • Current RN or LPN license in the state of practice.
  • Experience with MDS assessments and knowledge of CMS regulations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in MDS coordination or related field.
  • Experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of residents to complete the MDS documentation accurately.
  • Collaborate with nursing, therapy, and other departments to gather necessary patient information.
  • Train and educate staff on MDS processes, updates, and compliance requirements.
  • Analyze MDS data to identify trends and recommend improvements in patient care.
  • Ensure timely submission of MDS assessments to meet regulatory deadlines.

Skills:

The required skills for this position include strong analytical abilities to interpret MDS data and identify trends that can enhance patient care. title: Area Director, Southwest Alabama

description:

As a ministry leader, the Area Director directs the total program and work of the Southwest Alabama area (Mobile and Baldwin County) toward the accomplishment of its vision, mission, and goals. This involves the delivery of Christ-centered services to families and individuals seeking the services; relating to business, community, and government leaders and agencies; and maintaining relationships with pastors and churches in the area.

SPIRITUAL EXPECTATIONS

• A committed follower of Jesus Christ who is comfortable talking about their salvation.

• An active member of a local New Testament church.

• Demonstrates Christlike character, humility, and a commitment to discipleship and ministry to children and families.

• Familiarity with the general theological beliefs of Southern Baptists; agreement with specific truths in the Baptist Faith and Message; and agreement to conduct work in alignment with the Baptist Faith and Message.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

• Work with the CEO, CPO, Board of Trustees, and Service Team in developing program objectives and goals for the Southwest Alabama area; implement work toward strategic plans.

• Ensure the delivery of quality, Christ-centered services in all programs directly and by delegation.

• Lead the Southwest Alabama team to cooperate, communicate, and collaborate with the CPO and Administrative team members across the state, including the areas of Accounting, HR, IT, and Facility Maintenance, such that property, plants, and equipment are attractive, safe, and well-maintained.

title: Turkish Speaking Customer Advisor (Hybrid)
description:
• Job Title: Turkish-Speaking Travel Support Specialist / Customer Experience Advisor
  • Location: Lisbon, Portugal (Hybrid: 2–3 days remote work per week)
  • Employment Type: Full-Time | Regular Contract
  • Industry Focus: Online Travel, Hospitality & Global Reservation Services
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday (Daytime shifts: 07:00–16:00 & 08:00–17:00) — 100% Weekends Off!
  • Languages Required: Native or fluent Turkish (C1/C2) & Professional English (B2)

Important Notice & Work Authorization

  • Candidates Eligibility: Candidates must possess valid EU/EFTA Citizenship or an active Portuguese Residency Card at the time of application.
  • Note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or consider applicants without an established, legal right to work in Portugal.

About the Opportunity

Are you an articulate communicator with a customer-first mindset and a passion for the global travel industry? Join one of Europe's premier customer experience and business operations hubs located in the vibrant city of Lisbon!

In this dynamic role, you will represent one of the world's leading online travel platforms. Serving as a crucial bridge between travelers, accommodation providers, and transport partners, you will deliver high-touch customer care across Turkish-speaking markets. Whether assisting a traveler with a last-minute itinerary modification or coordinating directly with hotel partners, your dedication will directly impact customer satisfaction and create hassle-free travel experiences.

Key Responsibilities & Core Accountabilities

  • End-to-End Customer Care: Provide professional, efficient, and empathetic assistance to Turkish-speaking travelers via phone, email, and live messaging platforms regarding flight itineraries, hotel bookings, vehicle rentals, and holiday packages.
  • Reservation & Account Management: Process booking modifications, cancellations, refund requests, special assistance requests (e.g., accessibility requirements, dietary options), and billing/payment inquiries in a timely manner.
  • B2B Partner Liaison: Collaborate directly with hoteliers, property managers, airline representatives, and local travel agencies across global destinations to coordinate fast solutions for guest inquiries or operational disruptions.
  • Root-Cause Problem Solving: Investigate and resolve complex customer concerns, booking discrepancies, or service disruptions calmly and analytically, striving for single-contact resolution whenever possible.
  • Systems & Workflow Management: Accurately log, tag, and maintain interaction records, customer history, and ticketing statuses across modern CRM and database enterprise platforms.
  • Quality & Performance Standards: Consistently hit individual key performance indicators (KPIs), including Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Average Handle Time (AHT), and First Contact Resolution (FCR), while fully adhering to strict brand and confidentiality guidelines.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Essential Criteria

  • Legal Work Eligibility: Valid EU/EFTA Citizenship OR an active Portuguese Residency Card (Mandatory).
  • Language Proficiency: Native or fluent (C1/C2 level) in written and spoken Turkish, complemented by a solid working proficiency (B2 level) in English for internal communication, system navigation, and training modules.
  • Professional Experience: Prior experience in call centers, customer support, retail, hospitality, or travel agency operations is beneficial, but not required (candidates with strong interpersonal skills and an eagerness to learn are highly encouraged to apply!).
  • Technical Skills: Strong computer literacy, including comfortable navigation across multiple browser tabs, CRM systems, databases, and software tools simultaneously alongside fast typing and troubleshooting abilities.

Soft Skills

  • Active listening, high emotional intelligence, problem-solving capability, and the ability to maintain composure during high-volume periods or challenging customer interactions.

Compensation & Flexible Benefits Packages

To accommodate both local candidates and those relocating to Lisbon, we offer two comprehensive compensation packages:

  • Option 1: Standard Base Salary Package

    • Base Salary: €1,436.16 Gross / month (distributed across 12 monthly payments).
    • Additional Benefits: Monthly performance-based bonus opportunity, meal allowance allocated per working day, and standard local health/legal coverage.
  • Option 2: Relocation & Accommodation Package

    • Base Salary: €1,138.66 Gross / month (distributed across 12 monthly payments).
    • Company Accommodation: Private room provided in a fully furnished, shared company apartment (all major utility bills included: internet, electricity, water, and gas).
    • Travel Reimbursement: Initial flight ticket reimbursement upon successful completion of the probation period.
    • Airport Pickup & Onboarding Support: Dedicated relocation support team to assist with initial setup in Lisbon.

Work Arrangement & Shift Structure

  • Hybrid Work Model: Enjoy a balanced work environment with 2 to 3 days of work-from-home flexibility per week following successful completion of your initial training and nesting period in our modern Lisbon office.
  • Fixed Daytime Hours: Operational shifts run strictly Monday through Friday with rotating schedules:

    • Shift A: 07:00 – 16:00
    • Shift B: 08:00 – 17:00
  • Work-Life Balance: No weekend shifts! Saturdays and Sundays are completely free to enjoy Lisbon's beaches, culture, and cuisine.

What We Offer & Professional Growth

  • Fully Paid Onboarding Training: Comprehensive classroom and practical training covering customer relationship management systems, industry standards, and effective communication strategies.
  • Career Advancement Pathways: Over 80% of our management, quality assurance, training, and team leading positions are filled through internal promotions.
  • International Environment: Join a diverse, inclusive, and multi-cultural team representing dozens of nationalities under one roof.
  • Employee Wellbeing Programs: Access to health insurance options, internal wellness initiatives, company sports leagues, and organized cultural events throughout Lisbon.

title: Full Time - Assistant General Manager

Assistant General Manager - Large Commercial & Institutional Facilities | Wichita, KS

Lead Operations. Build Relationships. Make a Difference.

We're looking for an Assistant General Manager who thrives in a service-focused environment, values strong relationships, and takes pride in creating exceptional experiences for customers, tenants, and team members. If you're a collaborative leader who enjoys working with diverse teams and has a passion for operational excellence, we'd love to meet you.

At least 2 years of hotel engineering/maintenance experience.

Universal Chlorofluorocarbon (CFC) Certification

O nas

Nie sprzedajemy kliknięć. Pomagamy firmom rosnąć.

Jesteśmy agencją digital marketingu, która łączy performance marketing, SEO, analitykę, strategię i AI, aby pomagać firmom zwiększać sprzedaż i skalować biznes.

Działamy dynamicznie, myślimy ambitnie i nie boimy się testować nowych rozwiązań. Praca w Double Digital przypomina pracę w startupie - cenimy inicjatywę, samodzielność i szybkie działanie. Nie stoimy w miejscu: stale rozwijamy nasze kompetencje, szukamy nowych możliwości i doskonalimy sposób, w jaki pomagamy klientom osiągać ich cele biznesowe.

Stawiamy na konkretne efekty, partnerskie relacje i marketing oparty na danych. Lubimy ludzi, którzy chcą mieć wpływ, dostrzegają możliwości i potrafią przekuwać pomysły w działanie.

Teraz szukamy osoby, która pomoże nam rozwijać Double Digital jeszcze szybciej – aktywnie pozyskiwać nowych klientów, budować wartościowe relacje biznesowe i wspólnie tworzyć kolejne możliwości wzrostu.

Szukamy osoby, która nie czeka na gotowe leady, ale aktywnie buduje pipeline sprzedażowy. Kogoś, kto rozumie, że skuteczna sprzedaż usług B2B to nie tylko dobra prezentacja oferty, lecz przede wszystkim umiejętność zrozumienia potrzeb klienta, znalezienia właściwego rozwiązania i zbudowania relacji opartej na zaufaniu.

Twoje zadania

✅ Obsługa leadów inboundowych - kontakt z osobami zainteresowanymi współpracą, kwalifikacja zapytań i prowadzenie ich przez proces sprzedaży.

✅ Prowadzenie rozmów handlowych - poznawanie potrzeb klientów, diagnozowanie wyzwań biznesowych i identyfikowanie możliwości współpracy.

✅ Sprzedaż usług digital marketingu - prezentowanie rozwiązań z zakresu performance marketingu, SEO, analityki i strategii marketingowej.

✅ Przygotowywanie ofert i rekomendacji - współpraca ze specjalistami Double Digital przy tworzeniu rozwiązań dopasowanych do potrzeb i celów biznesowych klientów.

✅ Prowadzenie procesu sprzedaży end-to-end - od pierwszego kontaktu, przez spotkania i negocjacje, aż po podpisanie umowy.

✅ Rozwijanie pipeline’u sprzedażowego - systematyczne monitorowanie szans, follow-upy i dbanie o jakość procesu sprzedaży.

✅ Praca na celach i danych - analiza wyników, wyciąganie wniosków i optymalizacja własnych działań sprzedażowych.

Czego od Ciebie oczekujemy?

🚀 Umiejętności aktywnego pozyskiwania klientów i samodzielnego generowania szans sprzedażowych.

🚀 Swobody w prowadzeniu rozmów handlowych z właścicielami firm, zarządami i innymi osobami decyzyjnymi.

🚀 Umiejętności diagnozowania potrzeb klientów i przekładania ich na konkretne rozwiązania biznesowe.

🚀 Nastawienia na realizację celów, konsekwencji w działaniu i odpowiedzialności za wyniki.

✅ Sprzedaż usług, które mają biznesowe uzasadnienie - Nie musisz sprzedawać pustych obietnic. Naszą przewagą jest połączenie kompetencji z zakresu performance marketingu, SEO, analityki i strategii oraz koncentracja na mierzalnych efektach.

✅ AI i automatyzacja w praktyce - Wykorzystujemy AI na zaawansowanym poziomie, szukając sposobów na usprawnianie procesów, zwiększanie efektywności i eliminowanie powtarzalnych zadań. Pokażemy Ci, jak korzystać z narzędzi w codziennej pracy i pomożemy zautomatyzować zadania, które nie wymagają ręcznego wykonywania.

✅ Samodzielność i odpowiedzialność - Liczymy na inicjatywę i własne pomysły. Dajemy przestrzeń do działania, testowania rozwiązań i rozwijania skutecznego procesu sprzedaży.

✅ 100% pracy zdalnej - Pracujesz z dowolnego miejsca w Polsce, z nastawieniem na efekty i dobrą współpracę zespołową.

Jak działamy?

Job Description Summary

We are seeking strategic, customer-focused Cardiovascular (CV) Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) Market Development Leaders to accelerate growth across the ambulatory surgery center market. Each position will cover the East, Central, or Western U.S. and will identify, shape, and advance high-value ASC opportunities within the assigned region by engaging executive stakeholders, developing account and market strategies, and coordinating the full breadth of GE HealthCare capabilities around customer needs.

The role serves as the commercial orchestrator for complex opportunities, partnering with regional sales teams, product specialists, solution architects, marketing, finance, operations, and external ecosystem partners from early development through sales handoff and close.

Job Description

Responsibilities

· Regional Market and Opportunity Development: Build and execute a development plan for the assigned region. Identify priority markets, accounts, projects, partners, and new opportunities across cardiovascular and broader multi-modality CV ASC needs.

· Strategic Account Development: Develop executive relationships with CV ASC owners, operators, health systems, physician groups, private equity sponsors, management service organizations, developers, consultants, architects, and construction partners.

· Commercial Orchestration: Serve as the central development lead for complex CV ASC opportunities and align account executives, product specialists, solution architects, service, finance, applications, project management, and other stakeholders around one customer strategy.

· Discovery and Solution Shaping: Lead early-stage discovery covering the customer business model, clinical strategy, facility plan, timeline, capital approach, and decision process. Coordinate tailored, scalable solutions reflecting customer needs and GE HealthCare portfolio capabilities.

· Pipeline Creation and Advancement: Create, maintain, and advance a healthy regional pipeline of qualified CV ASC opportunities with clear milestones, stakeholders, risks, competitive position, next steps, and ownership.

· Sales Partnership and Handoff: Partner with regional and account sales leaders throughout the pursuit. Define a clear transition from development to sales execution while preserving strategy, executive alignment, and customer continuity.

· Ecosystem and Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with partners that influence CV ASC planning, development, financing, construction, management, and clinical operations.

· Market Intelligence: Monitor outpatient migration, regulatory and reimbursement developments, competitive activity, ownership changes, and new facility development, converting insights into regional commercial actions.

· Business Management and Governance: Maintain account plans, pursuit strategies, pipeline data, forecasts, and activity metrics. Communicate progress, barriers, resource needs, and market insights through regular operating reviews.

· Growth and Commercial Outcomes: Contribute to assigned operating-plan objectives through qualified pipeline generation, opportunity progression, strategic positioning, and support of CV ASC orders and revenue growth.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 5 years or a minimum of 8 years of selling, business development, market development, consulting, or promotion experience in medical technology, healthcare, a technical field, or life sciences.

  • Experience working in or with ambulatory surgery centers, cardiovascular care, healthcare systems, physician groups, medical technology, or related healthcare services.
  • Ability to develop and execute account and regional market strategies in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Strong business acumen connecting customer strategy, clinical needs, facility planning, capital priorities, and commercial solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex opportunities, influence without direct authority, and drive cross-functional accountability.
  • Ability to travel within the assigned region, up to 60% and located within one hour of a major airport.

Desired Characteristics

  • Firsthand ASC experience working with an MSO, private equity, or IDN-owned ASC, or current experience serving on an ASC-focused team.
  • Deep knowledge of the ASC market, outpatient migration, and the stakeholders involved in planning, building, financing, equipping, and operating an ASC.
  • Established relationships with ASC operators, MSOs, private equity firms, IDNs, physician groups, developers, consultants, architects, or management organizations.
  • Experience with cardiovascular, imaging, ultrasound, patient monitoring, anesthesia, digital, service, or multi-modality healthcare solutions.
  • Ability to lead structured discovery, build an executive-level value proposition, and translate strategy into a disciplined pursuit plan.
  • Strong analytical, project-management, and problem-solving skills.

Description

Shipping & Receiving Clerk

If you are a forward-thinking professional interested in manufacturing, shipping and receiving, and production operations, we invite you to explore this opportunity! We are seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Shipping & Receiving Clerk to join our Vertical Dimensions team at Vantage Elevation.

You’ll play a hands-on role in supporting the accurate and timely movement of incoming and outgoing materials and products. This position performs receiving, inspection, documentation, packaging, shipping, inventory, and general warehouse activities while helping ensure compliance with established safety and shipping requirements.

About Us

Vantage Elevation, LLC is an independent, industry-leading manufacturer of elevator components and systems with a long history of innovation and reliability. Founded in 1899, Vantage employs over 1,000 people across manufacturing sites and offices in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Through its family of brands, GAL Manufacturing, GAL Canada, Hollister-Whitney, Elevator Controls, Courion, Bore-Max, Thames Valley Controls, and Vertical Dimensions, Vantage supports nearly every electro-mechanical device used in modern elevators.

Vantage’s mission is to safely connect people and communities by providing reliable elevator solutions. We support our teams, work closely with our customers, and hold ourselves accountable for quality, safety, and integrity in everything we do.

Requirements

We are searching for a candidate with:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous shipping and receiving, warehouse, or related experience preferred.
  • Forklift experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of shipping and receiving procedures, documentation, and applicable requirements.
  • Basic computer proficiency.
  • Ability to accurately maintain shipping and inventory records.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work with precision.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.
  • Knowledge of workplace safety procedures and protocols.
  • Knowledge of basic hand tools.
  • Ability to accurately measure to within 1/16 of an inch.

Duties and Responsibilities

A typical day may include:

  • Receive and inspect incoming shipments of goods and materials.
  • Verify shipment contents for accuracy against applicable shipping documentation.
  • Record and track shipment information using computer systems or manual logs.
  • Package, label, and prepare outgoing shipments for delivery.
  • Select and arrange carriers and transportation methods based on shipment requirements and destination.
  • Coordinate with other departments to support timely and accurate shipment and delivery of materials and products.
  • Maintain inventory records and monitor stock levels.
  • Identify and report shipment discrepancies, damaged materials, or other shipping and receiving issues.
  • Follow applicable shipping regulations, company procedures, and safety standards.
  • Load and unload materials using a forklift as required.
  • Perform general warehouse duties and activities as needed.
  • Maintain an organized, safe, and efficient shipping and receiving work area.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements

The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including the ability to:

  • Lift and move boxes, packages, and materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Perform the physical activities associated with shipping, receiving, material handling, and general warehouse operations.
  • Safely operate a forklift when trained and authorized.

Benefits of Working With Us

  • Hourly pay: $24-$25 per hour for Washington-based applicants. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and applicable local requirements.
  • Paid Time Off and Sick Time.
  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance.
  • Life Insurance.
  • 401(K) Plan.
  • Tuition Reimbursement.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Position Details

  • Full-time, regular position.

Superior Group of Companies (SGC) · Fully Remote (or St. Petersburg, FL) · Full-Time

Superior Group of Companies (NASDAQ: SGC) is looking for a Senior Manager, Infrastructure to lead our enterprise infrastructure function — the technology backbone behind SGC Corporate, Superior (Healthcare Apparel), BAMKO, and TOG. If you came up through the network ranks — administrator, engineer, manager — and you're ready to own all of infrastructure and grow into broader IT leadership, this role was built for you.

The Opportunity

This is a succession-track hire, not a peer-level backfill. You'll report directly to our Chief Information Officer, own network, compute, storage, data protection, IT operations, end user services, M365 collaboration, and business continuity/disaster recovery, and lead a globally distributed team across the US, India, and Vietnam.

We're deliberately hiring at the manager / senior manager level and investing in your growth toward a Director role — and over a three- to four-year horizon, positioning you as a strong candidate for broader enterprise IT leadership. Along the way, you'll get structured exposure to business applications, project management, and business-facing IT leadership.

What You'll Own

  • Networking & Voice: the SGC network estate — firewalls, switching, routing, wireless, WAN/SD-WAN, and voice — across a mixed environment (SonicWall, Palo Alto, Ubiquiti)
  • Data Center & IT Operations: compute and storage (HPE, Lenovo, Dell PowerStore, HPE Nimble/SAN, AWS S3/Google Drive integrations), enterprise backup (Veeam, Datto, AWS S3), 24×7 monitoring, patching, and change execution
  • Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery: RTO/RPO definition, recovery testing, and capacity planning across on-prem and colocation environments
  • End User Services: IT Service Desk and ITSM (FreshService), endpoint management (NinjaOne), and Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams)
  • Team Leadership: coach, develop, and retain a globally distributed infrastructure team, building bench strength and growing your people's careers

What We're Looking For

  • A career grounded in networking: network administrator → network engineer → network/infrastructure manager (or a comparable path)
  • 8+ years of progressive infrastructure experience, including 4–5 years managing infrastructure teams
  • Deep hands-on expertise in switching, firewalls, routing, wireless, SD-WAN, and voice
  • Solid experience across data center operations: servers, storage, virtualization, backup/recovery
  • Proven team leadership — you've built, developed, and rallied a team to exceed expectations
  • Exceptional influence skills: you drive recommendations through expertise and trust, not positional authority
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field — or equivalent hands-on experience

Nice to Have

  • Managed Service Provider (MSP) background — managing teams that supported multiple client environments
  • Microsoft end user technology, email, and collaboration platform experience
  • Networking certifications (CCNA/CCNP, PCNSE) and/or ITIL Foundation
  • Experience in publicly traded, SOX-regulated environments
  • Experience supporting manufacturing or warehouse/distribution operations
  • Experience managing or working with offshore/distributed teams

Details

  • Location: St. Petersburg, FL or any approved remote state · Fully Remote workplace type
  • Travel: Occasional (~15–20%)
  • Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt (Salary)
  • Reports to: Chief Information Officer

title: IT Support Specialist
description:
Company Overview

Kristen Distributing Company is a local, family-owned beverage distribution company based in the Bryan/College Station area, with a rich history dating back to 1930 when it was founded in Bellville, Texas. Our mission at Kristen Distributing Company is to uphold the highest standards by providing exceptional beverages that align with the manufacturer’s marketing concepts. We are dedicated to fostering an environment that encourages personal independence, offers abundant opportunities, and prioritizes the development that enhances the strengths and dignity of our employees and customers.

Position Overview

The IT Support Specialist is KDC’s in-house technology resource and the first call for employees at the Bryan and Temple facilities when technology is not working. This position resolves day-to-day issues with laptops, email, phones, printers, logins, and security cameras, and owns KDC’s IT equipment from purchase through retirement.

The IT Support Specialist is also KDC’s day-to-day partner to GCS, our managed IT services provider, reviewing the security risks GCS identifies and the performance of company IT. The role leads practical and secure use of artificial intelligence at KDC, helping departments work faster without putting company, employee, or customer data at risk.

This position may be filled on a full-time or part-time basis, depending on the qualifications and availability of the selected candidate.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Help Desk and End-User Support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for employee technology issues, including laptops, email, company phones, printers, logins, password resets, and security cameras, providing support in person, by phone, and remotely.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve computer, network, and access issues, and escalate server and network infrastructure issues to GCS, KDC’s managed IT services provider, following them through resolution.
  • Install, configure, update, and maintain laptops, monitors, printers, peripherals, and meeting-room equipment at the Bryan and Temple facilities.
  • Monitor and maintain the security camera system at both facilities, and coordinate repairs with vendors.

Company Phones and Mobile Devices

  • Set up and issue company phones and laptops to new users, and reassign or deactivate lines when employees transfer or separate.
  • Manage company devices through Microsoft Intune and Apple Business Manager.
  • File and follow up on insurance claims for lost, stolen, or damaged company phones through Asurion.
  • Review monthly AT&T wireless invoices for unused lines, incorrect charges, and missing credits, and report discrepancies to Accounting.

User Accounts and Access

  • Monitor KDC’s automated user setup, which grants, changes, and removes system access based on Paycom new hires, position changes, and terminations, and confirm each change completed correctly.
  • Set up Encompass user accounts and manage user permissions.
  • Keep the company phone and email directory current, and make sure each employee’s work phone number and email are correct across company systems.
  • Make sure system access is removed on an employee’s last day, and that returned equipment is stored properly.

IT Equipment Inventory and Lifecycle

  • Maintain a complete inventory of company cell phones, warehouse devices, laptops, monitors, and other IT equipment, including who each item is assigned to, its condition, and its location.
  • Issue equipment to employees, document every assignment, and collect equipment when an employee separates, changes roles, or receives a replacement.
  • Keep a running replacement schedule showing each item’s age, warranty, and planned replacement date, and work with Accounting to budget replacements each year.
  • Obtain quotes, recommend purchases, submit them for approval, and order, receive, set up, and deploy new IT equipment.
  • Wipe and properly dispose of retired equipment so no company data leaves with it.

GCS Partnership and IT Performance

  • Serve as KDC’s day-to-day point of contact with GCS, opening and following up on tickets and projects.
  • Review security risks and alerts identified by GCS’s monitoring, recommend a course of action, and track each item through resolution.
  • Meet regularly with GCS to review the performance of KDC’s IT environment, open issues, and upcoming needs.
  • Track software licenses, subscriptions, and vendor renewals so KDC pays only for what it uses.

AI Tools and Automation

  • Administer KDC’s enterprise AI platform (Claude), including user accounts, settings, and permissions.
  • Work with department leaders to identify repetitive tasks that AI tools can automate or speed up, and help build and test those workflows.
  • Train employees on effective, secure use of AI tools through one-on-one help, quick-reference guides, and short group sessions.

Security, Reporting, and Documentation

  • Follow and promote security practices including multi-factor authentication, password standards, software updates, and phishing awareness, consistent with KDC’s cyber insurance requirements.
  • Prepare a quarterly IT activity report for leadership.
  • Write and maintain clear how-to guides and procedures for recurring IT tasks so processes are consistent and others can follow them.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Benefits

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, in office at the Bryan facility. Hours will be set based on whether the position is filled full-time or part-time, with occasional early, evening, or weekend work for system updates and urgent issues.
  • Compensation: $45,000–$65,000 per year, depending on experience and schedule.

If the position is filled full-time, the following benefits are also offered:

  • Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, with KDC contributing a substantial share of the employee-only premium.
  • Life Insurance: $30,000 company-paid policy at no cost to the employee, with supplemental coverage available.
  • Additional Coverage: Voluntary short-term and long-term disability, accident, and critical illness coverage.
  • 401(k): Eligible after three months of service; company match of 50% on the first 6% of employee contributions, with traditional and Roth options.
  • Paid Time Off: Five days after six months of service, ten days annually at one to four years, and fifteen days annually after five years, with up to five days carryover.
  • Paid Holidays: Eight paid holidays per year with no waiting period.
  • Uniforms: Three uniforms provided at hire, plus discounts on work boots.
  • Other: Employee Assistance Program including access to our on-staff counselor, discounted gym membership, bi-weekly pay, and direct deposit.

With a focus on teamwork, professional growth, and exceptional service, we're proud to offer more than just a job. We're a place to grow your career and be part of a team that makes a difference.


Elevate at 620 is seeking a full-time Assistant Manager to join our team! This position plays a key leadership role in the daily operations and overall success of the community, working closely with the Property Manager to drive leasing performance, resident satisfaction, and financial results.


The Assistant Manager will be responsible for leading and supporting the leasing team, overseeing resident engagement and retention efforts, managing lease renewals, and maintaining strong resident relationships. Additional responsibilities include monitoring delinquency, managing in-house collection efforts, assisting with marketing initiatives, and ensuring a positive resident experience throughout the leasing and residency lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of daily operations while supporting and developing the onsite team. In the absence of the Property Manager, the Assistant Manager will serve as the acting manager, providing leadership and ensuring the community continues to operate efficiently and successfully.


Assistant Manager Responsibilities:

· Support property marketing efforts, including outreach, social media engagement, and maintaining a positive online presence.

· Assist with resident concerns, conflict resolution, and ensuring timely follow-up to maintain positive resident relationships.

· Serve as the acting Property Manager in the Property Manager's absence, overseeing onsite operations, supporting team members, and addressing daily operational needs.

· Support the Property Manager in maintaining company policies, procedures, and operational standards.

title: VP of Commercial
description:
About Gulf Winds


Service Beyond Banking - At Gulf Winds, we are forward-thinking and team-oriented. We recognize and reward service that exceeds our members’ expectations and, most importantly, have fun while working hard and impacting our community. We’re looking for driven professionals who are passionate about service, fueled by purpose, and guided by core values of Integrity, Care, Growth, and Innovation


Our Values

Integrity

We own our decisions and actions by doing the right thing, learning from our mistakes, and taking responsibility.

Care

We help members meet their goals by listening to understand and offering the best solutions, placing kindness above all else.

Growth

We set ambitious goals, provide personal development opportunities, and encourage results.

Innovation

We challenge the status quo to enhance the member’s experience and solve tomorrow’s challenges today.


We Invest in Our People

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Benefits include 11.5 paid federal holidays, PTO starting at 18 days for new hires, 16 hours of paid volunteer time, competitively priced medical insurance, and dental and vision coverage with 100% of individual premiums paid by Gulf Winds. Team members also receive employer-paid life insurance, short-term disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, an employer-funded pension plan, flexible spending accounts, tuition reimbursement, and wellness programs.


Working at Gulf Winds

Working at Gulf Winds is not just a job, it’s a career. We’re hiring collaborative, motivated people who want to love what they do. We recognize and reward excellent member service and have fun while working hard. When you join the team, you can expect:

  • Open and transparent communication with your leaders
  • Consistent coaching and opportunities to improve performance.
  • Collaborative and team-focused environments
  • Short and long-term professional development
  • Opportunity to participate in cross-functional projects.

With you on our team we can achieve our vision of becoming the leading and most trusted credit union on the Gulf Coast.


Role:

The Vice President of Commercial provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all commercial lending processes, from origination through portfolio management. This employee is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and the delivery of high-quality service to commercial banking clients and internal stakeholders. The VP partners closely with the Chief Lending Officer, relationship managers, and risk management to drive efficiency, scalability, and profitability within the commercial lending function.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities:

15% Directs Operational Leadership: Oversees end-to-end commercial loan operations (processing through servicing); develops operational strategies aligned with growth objectives; establishes and monitors service level agreements (SLAs).

15% Manages Credit Administration: Supervises loan documentation review, covenant monitoring, and collateral management; ensures sound underwriting and timely credit decisions.

15% Leads Team Development: Mentors and develops operations professionals; fosters a high-performance culture; coordinates with Human Resources on talent acquisition and succession planning.

10% Implements Process Improvements: Drives continuous improvement initiatives using technology and automation; reduces cycle times and operational costs through best practices.

10% Ensures Regulatory Compliance: Maintains full compliance with federal and state regulations (BSA/AML, CRA, HMDA); serves as primary contact for regulatory examiners and internal/external auditors.

10% Optimizes Technology Systems: Champions the adoption of loan origination systems (LOS) and core banking platforms; identifies fintech partnerships and leads system implementations or upgrades.

10% Controls Operational Risk: Identifies trends in credit quality and delinquency; manages exception processes to resolve documentation deficiencies; coordinates risk assessments with Enterprise Risk Management.

5% Facilitates Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partners with Relationship Managers, Treasury, Finance, and Legal on complex deal structures and specific client requirements.

5% Provides Strategic Reporting: Leverages data analytics to provide actionable KPIs to management; represents department in senior leadership and board meetings.

5% Performs Other Related Duties: Completes additional tasks as assigned by management to support organizational goals.

Performance Measurements:

1. Maintains an average "Application to Funding" cycle time that meets or exceeds established benchmarks (e.g., reduction of 10% annually) without compromising credit quality or compliance standards.

2. Achieves a 95% or greater success rate in meeting internal SLAs for loan documentation, closing, and funding turnaround times to support Relationship Manager and member expectations.

3. Ensures zero "High Risk" audit findings related to loan documentation or collateral perfection and maintains a documentation exception rate of less than 5% of the total portfolio.

4. Ensures 100% of direct reports complete individual development plans (IDPs) and required regulatory training on schedule.

5. Successfully manages regulatory exams and internal audits with no repeated findings and ensures all identified deficiencies are remediated within 60 days.

6. Demonstrates measurable gains in staff productivity (e.g., increased loan volume per FTE) resulting from the successful implementation or optimization of the Loan Origination System (LOS).

7. Manages the Commercial Operations budget within a +/- 5% variance and identifies at least one initiative annually that reduces operational costs per loan through automation or process redesign.

Knowledge and Skills:

Experience Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in commercial lending, credit administration, or loan operations within a bank, credit union, or financial institution. Minimum of 5 years in a management role overseeing operational teams. Demonstrated experience managing a commercial loan portfolio of $100M or greater. Experience with construction, C&I, CRE, and SBA lending preferred.

Education Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field preferred. MBA or advanced degree preferred. Completion of a formal bank credit training program is a strong plus.

Interpersonal Skills Work involves extensive personal contact with others and is of a personal or sensitive nature. Motivating, influencing, and/or training others is key at this level. Outside contacts become important and fostering sound relationships with other entities (companies and/or individuals) becomes necessary and often requires the ability to influence and/or sell ideas or services to others.

Other Skills Deep knowledge of commercial credit underwriting, loan documentation, and portfolio management principles.

Thorough understanding of regulatory guidelines, NCUA requirements, and state banking laws.

Proficiency with loan origination systems (e.g., nCino, Sageworks, Baker Hill) and core banking platforms (e.g., Jack Henry, FiServ, Temenos).

Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence across organizational levels.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive teams and boards.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Physical Requirements This role requires sitting at a computer for most of the day. This role would also require the ability to file files, open filing cabinets, and bend or stand as necessary. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment The position is based in-office in our Pensacola, FL market, operates primarily in an office setting, and routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, printers, and phones. This position requires consistent presence in the office to effectively collaborate with team members and fulfill job responsibilities. It requires the ability to actively participate in conference calls and meetings with other Credit Union team members and vendors. The normal expected work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:30a.m. to 5:00p.m. Occasional after-hours work or travel may be required to meet project deadlines or attend conferences, seminars, or client meetings. Must adhere to safety rules and regulations.

This Job Description is not a complete statement of all duties and responsibilities comprising the position.

Gulf Winds is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace.

title: Data Analytics & Business Intelligence Consultant (Senior Associate level)
description:
About the Company

Eagle Hill is a nationally recognized, award-winning consulting firm, based in the Washington, DC area. We pride ourselves on our unconventional approach to solving business challenges, with a focus on delivering value above expectations. Our collective of talented consultants encourages each other to bring their unique perspectives and experiences to deliver impact-focused solutions for our clients. The result is a working environment that encourages bold thinking, collaboration and delivering client-centered solutions.

Job Description

Eagle Hill is seeking candidates to fill current and potential data analytics and business intelligence roles for U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) client projects. These projects will provide analytical, strategic, and operational support to enable CBP offices to use data more effectively, modernize operations, improve business processes, and strengthen mission delivery. Applicants must be willing and able to work on client sites within the Washington, DC metro area on a daily basis or as required by the client.

Ideally, candidates will bring both strong consulting capabilities and meaningful, hands-on data analytics and business intelligence experience. We also recognize that candidates may have developed greater depth in one area while building substantive, applied experience in the other.

This is neither a general project management role with limited technology exposure nor a purely technical role with limited responsibility for business outcomes.

Applicants must be willing and able to work on client sites within the Washington, DC metro area on a daily basis or as required by the client.

About the Opportunity

At Eagle Hill, Senior Associates develop firsthand knowledge of our clients, their operating environments, and their business challenges and use that understanding to contribute to analysis, solutions, and client deliverables. title: PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER II
location: San Diego, California, San Diego, CA, US
description:
Sanford Burnham Prebys is much more than a research facility and hub for innovation; it’s a vibrant global community of talented scientists and researchers from over 30 countries. This worldwide representation enriches our perspectives and enhances our creative approach to solving complex scientific challenges.

We strive to be leaders not only in biomedical research but also in creating an environment where excellence thrives through collaboration across cultures and backgrounds. Our mission is to advance the biomedical sciences by cultivating the next generation of scientific leaders, providing meaningful opportunities for researchers of all backgrounds to learn, innovate, and make breakthrough discoveries that improve human health.

Together, we translate science into health.

The duties and responsibilities contained in the job description are intended to be examples of the accountabilities for which the person in the position will demonstrate competency through performance. The job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Duties and responsibilities are subject to change and other duties may be assigned as necessary.

Position Summary:

This senior technology role in the institute’s NCI-designated Cancer Center will be responsible for technical leadership in applying software engineering techniques to the processing and management of complex biomedical data. They will be responsible for architecting and implementing sophisticated, multi-language, modular software that works scalably with very large datasets. Software tasks will support aspects ranging from SDLC (including dev/ops and overall software development practices), data ingestion, quality-control, feature-extraction, data-visualization, scalable analyses including parallelization and concurrency, full-stack interfaces, containerization and load-sensitive software design. This will require a very strong background in both theoretical and applied computer science, with particular benefit to previous software engineering experience dealing with complex scientific or other datasets.

The successful candidate will have experience in designing and implementing software solutions in a wide range of programming languages and computing environments. They will have a particular emphasis on deploying design, analysis and programming skills to create systems that improve code-quality and boost productivity of large development teams of mixed skillsets. In particular, they will work closely with bioinformaticians, cloud ops and other related positions. They will provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior staff, including software engineers and trainees. They will be responsible for identifying technical opportunities, including recognition of new algorithms and software development opportunities including taking advantage of AI assisted development tools and cloud resources. They may be involved in assembling and submitting funding applications. They may have external-facing roles, including interactions with collaborating research groups, commercial entities and other partner organizations. They will provide technical support to other researchers. They will also serve as a point of expertise throughout the organization in computer science and software engineering. They will be expected to generate peer-reviewed scientific research, both as a lead and as a collaborator. They will work in a variety of statistical and programming environments. They will be expected to contribute actively to open-source software development. They will set project milestones collaboratively with the PI, then manage themselves and other technical staff to meet them.

Amongst their key early roles will be standing up a robust software-development infrastructure for the rapidly-growing Institute cancer data science group. This will involve close collaborations across the Institute, particularly with the Center for Data Science.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design and implement robust software development practices
  • Architect and develop complex software for cancer data science in a variant of programming languages choosing which is best suited to project needs, and taking advantage of AI assisted development tools
  • Optimize software for high-performance computing environments, including use of containerization, dev/ops, test-driven development and other software- and cloud-engineering techniques
  • Assist with systems administration, liaising closely with Dev/Ops, Sys/Ops and Cloud/Ops
  • Write high-quality, user-facing and developer-facing documentation
  • Mentor junior staff, fostering improved software development and technical growth
  • Implement, employ, and optimize AI-based software development tools
  • To effectively present results and ideas related to assigned projects both verbally and in writing to both computational and experimental scientists.
  • Performs other related tasks, duties and responsibilities as required, assigned, or directed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: MS degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related discipline

Experience: Fifteen (15) years of progressive software engineering roles, with at least 10 years working in a biomedical computing environment

  • Fluency in at least three of python, C#, C++, R, Nextflow and bash
  • Documented ability to drive process-improvement in software development, including dev/ops
  • Experience administering complex software source-code control environments
  • At least 10 years of HPC experience in a containerized environment
  • Experience working with SQL and database technology

Certifications, Licenses, etc: None

Other Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities:

  • Work independently as well as in a team environment
  • Be responsible, organized, and a problem solver
  • Possess strong attention to detail, analytical, time management, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills

title: Technology Risk & Controls Lead (Auckland or Wellington)
description:

This is an opportunity to step into a newly created senior role within our Cyber Security team and help strengthen the way NZ Post manages technology risk, assurance and compliance. Reporting to the Technology Risk & Compliance Manager, you'll act as a trusted advisor across Data & Technology, helping our leaders understand risk, make informed decisions and continuously improve our control environment.

You'll work across a broad range of activities, from facilitating risk assessments and reporting on technology risk posture, through to supporting audits, managing third-party risk and helping evolve our Integrated Risk Management platform, Protecht. You may already be operating in a lead-level technology risk, cyber risk, assurance or governance role, or be ready to step into one. What matters most is your ability to bring people together, drive improvements and provide confidence that risks and controls are being managed effectively.

You'll combine that with

description:
• Job Title: IT Platform Engineer
  • Location: Hamburg, Germany (Hybrid: 2–3 days per week on-site)
  • Industry: Non-Profit / Health-Tech
  • Compensation: €65,000 – €90,000 gross p.a. (commensurate with experience) + comprehensive benefits package
  • Experience Required: 3+ years
  • Language Requirements: German (B2+ required) & English (Proficient)
  • Employment Type: Full-time

About Us & Our Mission

We are a non-profit health-tech organization at the forefront of digital healthcare innovation. Our core mission is to make advanced Artificial Intelligence practical and accessible across the medical field—reducing the burden on clinical staff while directly elevating patient care. By engineering localized, sovereign technology solutions, we strengthen the independence and resilience of healthcare infrastructure.

We are seeking an experienced IT Platform Engineer to assume end-to-end ownership of our internal platform, cloud infrastructure, and security compliance framework within an agile, high-impact organization.

Role Overview

In this role, you will architect, maintain, and refine our core internal platforms, identity and access controls, collaborative toolchains (GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Confluence, M365), and overarching security infrastructure. You will play a pivotal role in establishing ISO 27001 and BSI C5 compliance standards while managing a modern, greenfield platform built on Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and sovereign cloud environments (e.g., STACKIT, clinical data centers).

This position offers a transparent career progression path toward IT Security / Compliance Lead, working in close partnership with executive leadership (CTO).

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration & Operations:

    • Manage, tune, and scale Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD environments (encompassing SSO, Conditional Access, MFA, and licensing).
    • Configure, integrate, and maintain internal developer and collaboration tools, including Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitLab, and Microsoft 365.
    • Deploy and support infrastructure components across clinical data centers and German cloud providers utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, GitLab CI, and GPU servers.
    • Act as the primary technical contact for internal platform support, user administration, and system configurations.
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) & Compliance:

    • Architect, implement, and document robust RBAC, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM integrations.
    • Build and lead BSI C5 and ISO 27001 compliance frameworks from the ground up, driving ISMS design, audit readiness, and alignment with ISO 13485 standards.
    • Maintain audit-proof, structured documentation to guarantee an exceptionally secure enterprise environment.
  • Automation & Operational Efficiency:

    • Streamline user onboarding/offboarding workflows, license tracking, and security enforcement through scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, Ansible) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
    • Oversee system telemetry, configure alerting frameworks, and conduct proactive troubleshooting to guarantee high availability.
    • Handle IT vendor relationships, oversee SaaS licensing efficiency, and minimize operational overhead.

Requirements & Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • Experience: At least 3 years of hands-on experience in IT administration, systems engineering, or platform operations.
  • IAM Expertise: Deep familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD alongside standard IAM protocols (RBAC, SAML, OIDC, SCIM).
  • Tooling: Demonstrated success administering M365, Jira, Confluence, and Git-based platforms (GitHub/GitLab).
  • Security & Compliance: Proven track record in building, maintaining, or auditing ISO 27001 or BSI C5 compliance frameworks/ISMS.
  • Languages: Working proficiency in German (B2+ spoken and written required) and fluent English skills.

title: German Speaking Tax Specialist (on-site)
description:

About the Role

Are you an experienced tax professional seeking a long-term career opportunity within an expanding, highly collaborative tax practice?

We are looking for a dedicated Steuerfachangestellte/r or Steuerfachwirt/in to join a supportive, multi-generational team based in Bamberg. If you desire a role with substantial autonomy, adaptable working hours, and clear personal accountability—including the option to step into a leadership function within payroll—we welcome your application!

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Accounting & Statements: Oversee full financial accounting (Finanzbuchhaltung) and prepare draft annual financial statements for an assigned portfolio of small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) clients across various industry sectors.
  • Payroll Accounting & Ownership: Manage accurate monthly payroll processing (Lohnbuchhaltung) and optionally take on a lead role overseeing practice-wide payroll operations and complex tax topics.
  • DATEV Optimization & System Migration: Actively support and help structure the ongoing transition of client mandates and payroll workflows to DATEV, maximizing the use of digital DATEV modules across the firm.
  • Client Advisory: Function as a primary, trusted point of contact for corporate clients regarding routine accounting, payroll inquiries, and general financial matters.
  • Quality Assurance & Collaboration: Review accounting deliverables from junior team members where appropriate, track statutory tax deadlines, and continuously refine internal office processes.
  • Optional Mandate Expansion: Opportunity to onboard and independently manage your own client mandates if desired, directly contributing to the firm's commercial growth.

Candidate Profile

Must-Haves

  • Education & Qualification: Successfully completed vocational training as a Tax Clerk (Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r). Advanced qualifications such as Tax Specialist (Steuerfachwirt/in) or Certified Accountant (Bilanzbuchhalter/in) are welcome, provided you hold a foundational tax clerk background.
  • DATEV Proficiency: Multiple years of practical, hands-on experience utilizing DATEV applications (spanning both accounting and payroll software suites).
  • Payroll Expertise: Solid operational experience in handling payroll and a strong readiness to manage payroll duties as part of your regular schedule.
  • Language Skills: C1 level or higher German fluency to communicate clearly with clients, internal colleagues, and municipal tax authorities.
  • On-site Presence: Commitment to working primarily on-site in Bamberg (with ad-hoc remote work options by mutual agreement following onboarding), living in or within reasonable daily commuting distance.
  • Mindset: Collaborative team-oriented attitude, high personal drive, and a practical, hands-on approach to daily responsibilities.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Successfully completed advanced qualification as a Steuerfachwirt/in.
  • Hands-on experience with software implementation, process automation, or digital tax office workflows.
  • Professional ambition and capability to take on a functional management role within the firm's payroll unit.
  • Ability or interest in bringing an existing client mandate portfolio to the firm (optional).

What We Offer (Core Benefits)

  • Attractive Compensation: Competitive annual gross salary between €36,000 and €60,000 (monthly gross pay ranging from €3,000 to €5,000 based on experience and professional qualifications).
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Flexible scheduling options ranging from 25 to 40 hours per week, 30 paid annual vacation days, and ad-hoc home office flexibility post-onboarding.
  • Long-Term Security: Permanent employment contract (full-time or part-time) within a stable, growing tax office led by three active tax partners (Berufsangehörige).
  • Great Office Culture: A welcoming, family-like working environment featuring a diverse, multi-generational team, helpful peers, and regular company social events (including summer gatherings and holiday celebrations).
  • High Degree of Impact: Extensive freedom to help shape digital DATEV workflows and assume direct ownership over key operational service areas.

title: Finance Coordinator
description:
Are you looking to broaden your financial experience, develop new skills and take on greater responsibility? Would you welcome the opportunity to gain experience in a different part of the University while contributing to an exciting period of change?

We are seeking an experienced finance professional from within the University of Cambridge to join our Development and Alumni Relations team on a 12-month secondment.

This is an opportunity to expand your financial management experience, take ownership of a varied portfolio of responsibilities and play an important role in supporting the financial operations of a busy and collaborative department.

**Why this role? Why now?**

Development and Alumni Relations plays a vital role in building relationships with alumni and supporters, securing philanthropic investment that advances the University's ambitions in education and research.

Behind this work is a dedicated Finance team, ensuring our financial operations are managed effectively and providing essential support to colleagues across the department.

You will join us at an exciting time for University finance, with the introduction of Oracle Fusion creating opportunities to improve systems, streamline processes and develop new ways of working.

You will help support this transition while taking responsibility for key financial activities, contributing to management reporting and providing day-to-day supervision of our Finance Assistants.

**What you'll do**

- Oversee day-to-day financial operations, including purchasing, invoicing, expenses, banking and financial reconciliations.

- Support the Finance Manager with the preparation of management accounts, financial analysis, budget monitoring and reporting.

- Provide day-to-day supervision and guidance to the Finance Assistants, supporting their development and ensuring an efficient finance service.

- Advise colleagues on financial policies, procedures and regulations, ensuring compliance with University requirements.

- Build effective relationships across the department, providing financial guidance and contributing to continuous improvement.


**Who we're looking for**

We are looking for an organised, proactive and collaborative finance professional who enjoys taking responsibility, solving problems and supporting colleagues.

You'll bring:

- Substantial experience in finance and accounting, ideally gained within a complex organisational environment.

- An AAT qualification or equivalent practical experience.

- Strong financial and analytical skills, with confidence using Excel and financial accounting systems.

- Strong communication skills with the confidence to advise and support colleagues at different levels.

- A collaborative approach, sound judgement and enthusiasm for developing new skills and embracing change.


**Why join Development and Alumni Relations?**

You'll join a friendly, ambitious and supportive department of more than 160 colleagues, working together to help advance the University's wider ambitions.

Our Finance team plays an important role in making this possible, providing the expertise, guidance and financial oversight that enable colleagues to deliver their work effectively.

Whether you're looking to develop your supervisory experience, strengthen your financial management skills or expand your professional network, this secondment offers an opportunity to explore a different area of the University while continuing your career development.

We also recognise the importance of flexibility. The role is offered at 80% of full-time hours (29.6 hours per week), with flexibility to work across four or five days. Hybrid working is available, with an expectation of two days per week on-site, to be agreed with the Finance Manager.
