title: Therapeutic Rec Aide 4-10s
description:
HIGHLAND-CLARKSBURG HOSPITAL

JOB DESCIPTION

THERAPEUTIC RECREATION AIDE

JOB SUMMARY:

Conducts comprehensive recreational therapy services designed to facilitate the psychosocial rehabilitation of psychiatric patients in an acute psychiatric health care facility. Reports directly to the Therapeutic Recreation Director.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTION:

  1. Explains the benefits and orients patients to the therapeutic recreation program.
  2. Devotes time specifically, interacting with the patients and staying the duration of the session.
  3. Observing patient's interest levels and behaviors while motivating her/him toward therapeutic recreation activities which are beneficial to them. Maintains an awareness of patient's needs and individual goals.
  4. Leading and executing planned therapeutic recreation sessions.
  5. Understands the abilities and special needs of specific age groups.
  6. Completes documentation accurately and timely including intervention used and patients progress.
  7. Listens attentively to any patient complaints and works in a positive manner to help alleviate the problem. Assists in limit setting in a firm but kind manner, treating all individuals with respect and kindness.
  8. Assists patients in developing an understanding of benefits of ongoing health and fitness. Assist patients to improve social interaction, coping skills, problem solving, anger management skills and any skills that relates to address the functioning of the therapeutic recreation domains (physical, emotional, cognitive, social and spiritual) to increase overall quality of life.
  9. Maintain safety checks for therapeutic recreation supplies including counting all supplies before and after group ensuring no supplies are missing.
  10. Conducts therapeutic recreation assessment on each patient within 48 hours admission. Long-term patients will be reassessed yearly for any changes.
  11. Maintains observation of patients and shares appropriate information with charge nurse, supervisor and other co-workers.
  12. Maintains cleaning logs for multipurpose rooms, supplies and equipment.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Receives a thorough report from nursing staff before taking patients to off unit group activities and before providing on unit therapeutic recreation sessions.
  2. Attends and participates in Recreation department meetings and may be asked to work on committees or teams.
  3. Understanding treatment planning process and how it correlates with providing active treatment interventions for quality outcome based recreation therapy to help reach goals.
  4. Works with the multidisciplinary treatment team to develop and implement individualized therapeutic recreation interventions.
  5. Self-motivating - does not need to be reminded of specific or general duties by peers or supervisor. Works well and cooperates with staff in other departments. Reports concerns in a timely manner to direct supervisor.
  6. Performs non-patient duties between responsibilities such as cleaning sinks, art room counters at the end of day, and putting exercise equipment away. May be asked to transport patients to various therapeutic recreation activities, and attend therapeutic community outings.
  7. Checks with supervisor to approve spending.
  8. Maintains supplies and keeps inventory, ordering from central supply and kitchen.
  9. Keeps aware and helps enforce hospital and departmental policies and procedures.
  10. May assist in orientation of new employees.
  11. Must learn to use various copiers or fax machines.
  12. Exercises good judgment and sets positive examples, using TQM principals.
  13. Other duties as assigned.

title: Gameplay Technical Lead (For Honor)
description:
#### Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in video games, with teams spread across the four corners of the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin's Creed to Rainbow Six, including Just Dance and many more. We believe that diversity of perspectives drives progress for both players and teams. If you are passionate about innovation and want to push the boundaries of entertainment, join our adventure and help us create the unknown!

#### Job Description

As a gameplay technical lead, you will act as a specialist in your field and rely on lessons from the past to guide decisions in the present and plan proactively for the future. Your main area will be gameplay, but you will also be expected to contribute to animation and UI.

You will lead a team of programmers toward a technical vision and turn it into reality through high-quality code and solutions to overcome its constraints.

You will be responsible for helping your team develop its skills; that is why you will support and mentor its members. You will give them the means to innovate and give their best.

Given your expertise, credibility and reliability, not only the developers on your project but others as well will be able to turn to you for information and guidance. You will be a go-to resource, a true source of advice and a reference for Ubisoft employees around the world.

**What you will do**

- Define the **technical vision** in your area of specialization (gameplay, animation and UI) + plan its technical roadmap.
- Meet regularly with your **programming team** to discuss progress, overcome obstacles, share updates, present features, give feedback, and explain in an informative and constructive way the causes of risks and issues, etc.
- **Mentor** and **motivate** programmers to develop their technical skills + provide what the team needs to work efficiently and achieve quality (tools, pipelines, etc.).
- Write **elegant code** tailored to the hardware you are working on.
- Ensure **technical oversight** by reviewing code and performing technical validations.
- **Anticipate** and assess complex and urgent problems + propose suitable solutions.
- Collaborate with other technical leads to remove blockers and keep production moving.
- Communicate with interdependent teams on other projects to **exchange** information.
- **Stay up to date** on technological advances and industry standards to define our best practices + share them with our studios.

#### Qualifications

**What you bring to the team**

- An undergraduate degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, or equivalent
- About 7 years of programming experience + 2 years of technical leadership
- A deep understanding of a variety of game engines (Anvil is considered an asset), systems, programming languages (C++ required, C# is considered an asset), interdependencies and critical issues
- Experience on a live game is considered an asset
- The ability to make informed, immediate decisions with minimal long-term repercussions
- A strategic approach to problem-solving: you don't just temporarily fix problems, you solve them so they don't recur
- Excellent mentoring, interpersonal and presentation skills
- A collaborative and innovative mindset
- Effective cross-department communication: you can easily communicate with all disciplines + break down complex information for different audiences
- A desire to share your knowledge to push the limits of technology & help others improve their skills

**What to send us**

Your resume highlighting your education, experience, skills and, where applicable, shipped games

title: Integrations Engineer II
description:
Integrations Engineer II

Job Type Location Salary Range
Full-Time | On-Site Renton, WA $36.50 - $45.70 per hour

Job Summary

The primary role of the Integrations Engineer II is to design, build, and support the APIs and event-driven services that connect Radiant's transportation management platform with our customers, carriers, partners, and internal applications.

  • The Integrations Engineer II is a member of the API & Integrations team. The team builds on a modern cloud platform (Node.js/TypeScript on AWS) that delivers REST APIs, event streaming, and AI-enabled services.

  • This is a hands-on, mid-level engineering role. The incumbent owns assigned integrations from technical design through production support, and is a go-to reviewer and mentor for less experienced engineers.

  • The Integrations Engineer II works with engineers in the U.S. and Cebu, Philippines, and with partner teams across Technology and Operations.

  • The incumbent works free from daily oversight, regularly exercising independent discretion and significant decision making in regard to completing duties.

Key Responsibilities

In this position, the Integrations Engineer II is responsible for:

Design & Build

  • Design and build customer- and partner-facing REST APIs, including specifications, validation, versioning, and documentation.

  • Develop event-driven services and data pipelines that move and transform data between our transportation management system and connected systems.

  • Own the technical design of assigned integrations: write solution designs, weigh trade-offs, and propose improvements to performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Onboard new customers and partners onto integration flows, from data mapping and testing through go-live.

  • Assist API clients with their technical needs, including onboarding and setup, troubleshooting, and escalated issues.

  • Contribute to AI-enabled services that give AI tools safe, governed access to integration capabilities.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools and automation to speed up delivery and remove repetitive setup and support work.

Quality & Release

  • Write automated tests and keep the team's CI pipelines healthy.

  • Review code and approve changes for promotion to staging, in line with team standards.

  • Mentor Integrations Engineer I team members through development, code review, and documentation.

Support & Reliability

  • Share ownership of the team's core production services with other engineers, so no service or approval depends on a single person.

  • Monitor the team's integrations and lead the triage of production incidents for the services you own: find the root cause, put fixes in place, and document what happened.

  • Act as a technical backup to the Engineering Manager for design decisions and release approvals when needed.

  • Help modernize legacy integrations by moving them onto the current platform.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work from business requirements documents (BRDs), and contribute technical requirements and estimates.

  • Partner with the teams that own connected platforms to validate new or changed interfaces, report defects, and confirm fixes.

  • Keep runbooks and API documentation current so the wider team and the Helpdesk can support integrations.

  • Handle customer and partner data securely, in line with company security practices.

  • Other duties as may be assigned by management.

Qualifications & Skills

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Minimum 4 years' experience in backend software engineering or systems integration.

  • Strong backend development experience in Node.js/TypeScript.

  • Experience designing REST APIs, including authentication, versioning, and documentation.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and message streaming (e.g., Kafka).

  • Experience operating event-streaming pipelines in production, including throughput, lag, and recovery.

  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ERP, TMS, or similar), including data mapping.

  • Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

  • Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), containers, and CI/CD.

  • Track record of owning services in production, including monitoring, incident response, and root-cause analysis.

  • Experience reviewing code and mentoring other engineers.

  • Strong written communication and the discipline for asynchronous work across time zones (U.S. Pacific ↔ Philippines).

  • Proficient in English communication (verbal and written).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating with SAP TM or other enterprise TMS/ERP platforms.

  • Experience building data pipelines or change-data-capture solutions.

  • Experience with observability tooling (logs, metrics, and tracing).

  • Experience building AI/LLM integrations or using AI-assisted development tools.

title: Security Specialist - CI
description:
SUMMARY

General Description:

Under direct supervision of the Chief of Security, the Counterintelligence (CI) & Intelligence Analyst is primarily responsible to serve as a strategic advisor. This pivotal role is responsible for the comprehensive protection of the Mid-Atlantic Regional Spaceport, requiring the synthesis of classified, proprietary, and open-source intelligence to identify and mitigate risks from foreign intelligence entities, economic espionage, and insider threats. By developing proactive threat assessments and maintaining robust liaison relationships with federal and state partners, the Analyst will provide the executive leadership with the critical situational awareness necessary to safeguard high-value launch infrastructure, intellectual property, and national security interests in an increasingly complex aerospace threat environment.

Responsibilities and Duties:

  1. SOC Leadership: Oversee the daily operations of our private Security Operations Center, ensuring compliance for and proper operation of all monitoring systems, communication loops, and incident response protocols.
  1. Intelligence Synthesis: Collect and analyze data from OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence), social media threads (SOCMINT), deep/dark web monitoring, law enforcement partnerships and proprietary feeds to identify emerging threats.
  1. Threat Mapping: Develop and maintain a comprehensive "Threat Picture" for the spaceport, focusing on everything from corporate espionage and physical protests to geopolitical instability and cyber-physical risks.
  1. Executive Briefings: Translate complex intelligence data into concise, high-impact briefings and visualizations for company leadership.
  1. Proactive Monitoring: Identify patterns in social media and fringe forums to anticipate "flashpoint" events before they reach our perimeter.
  1. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Physical Security and Cyber teams to ensure intelligence is integrated into real-world tactical responses.


EMPLOYMENT STANDARDS

General Education: High School Diploma or Equivalent

College: Bachelor’s degree - Preferred Major: Internal Relations, Criminal Justice, Intelligence Studies or a related field

Job-Related Experience - Preferred:

  • 4+ years in intelligence analysis (Military, Law Enforcement, or High-End Private Sector)
  • Mastery of OSINT methodologies, SOC management and SOC management software, and threat intelligence platforms (TIPS)
  • Exceptional writing and briefing skills. Ability to explain a “distributed Denial of Service” or a “Physical Breach Strategy” in three bullet points.
  • Previous experience in aerospace, defense or critical infrastructure security

Certifications: Minimum Clearance level – Secret; Must have the ability to obtain and maintain an active TS SCI security clearance with CI polygraph

Licenses, etc.: Valid driver's license is necessary when operating a vehicle while on agency business


CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

Knowledge:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of security policies, practices, and principles
  • Familiarity with different security procedures and protocols
  • Knowledgeable of de-escalating techniques
  • Incident response awareness

Skills:

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Organization and attention to detail
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office or related programs

Abilities:

  • Time management with a proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Demonstrates high professionalism in dealing with confidential and sensitive issues
  • A Signal Finder: You have a preternatural ability to find the needle in the haystack. You know that 99% of data is noise, and you’re obsessed with the 1% that matters.
  • Tech-Savvy Analyst: You are proficient with OSINT tools (e.g., Maltego, SpiderFoot, Dataminr, or Babel Street) and understand how to leverage automated scrapers without losing the "human touch" of analysis.
  • Strategically Minded: You understand that security at a spaceport isn't just about fences; it’s about protecting intellectual property, public reputation, and the nation-state bad actors.

The demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

In certain situations, employee may be asked to respond to emergencies, during work hours or outside of work hours, based on the needs of the Authority.

Physical Demands:

  • Regularly required to sit; use hands to manipulate, handle, or feel and talk or hear.
  • Frequently required to reach with hands and arms.
  • Occasionally required to stand; walk; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and taste or smell.
  • Must regularly lift and /or move up to 40 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Mental/Sensory:

  • Employee conveys information and ideas clearly, both orally and in written English.
  • Anticipates, prevents, identifies, and solves problems in the workplace.
  • Assimilates complex information. Listens to, comprehends, and clarifies concerns and issues raised by colleagues and clients.
  • Emergency situations may present unpredictable scenarios, not anticipated in this job description.

Emotional:

  • Works well in stressful, high-pressure work environment.
  • Maintains composure and objectivity.
  • Is respectful.
  • Works with diverse personalities and levels.
  • Exercises a high degree of discretion when handling confidential data, documents, correspondences, and other information.
  • Handles multiple priorities and adapts to frequent change.


Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals and risk of electrical shock. The employee is frequently exposed to risk of radiation and vibration.

Work environment involves significant risks with exposure to potentially dangerous or extremely adverse conditions which require a range of safety and other precautions, e.g. fieldwork on launch pads, near high pressure and cryogenic systems, near extremely energetic materials.

The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions (non-weather); working near moving mechanical parts; outdoor weather conditions; extreme cold (non-weather) and extreme heat (non-weather). The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

Must be able to obtain and maintain eligibility for issuance of a NASA base credential.

Must be able to pass a pre-employment background check and drug test.

title: Technical Artist UI (March of Giants)
description:
#### Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in video games, with teams spread across the four corners of the world who create original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin's Creed to Rainbow Six, including Just Dance and many more. We believe that diversity of perspectives drives progress for both players and teams. If you are passionate about innovation and want to push the boundaries of entertainment, join our adventure and help us create the unknown!

#### Job Description

As a UI Technical Artist at Ubisoft Montréal, you will contribute to the integration and implementation of the game's interfaces and navigation flow in the Unreal game engine. You will transform user interface mockups into functional, high-performing and visually consistent interfaces, while respecting the project's technical constraints and collaborating closely with the user experience, UI art and UI engineering teams.

**What you will do**

- Integrate **menus** and **game navigation flow** systems in **Unreal** using **UMG** and **Blueprint**
- Break down **UI** mockups into reusable "**widgets**", interface structures and logic
- Implement **menu animations** and interactive behaviors
- Optimize **UI** performance related to the **CPU**, **memory**, **textures** and **materials**
- Collaborate with the **user experience**, **UI art** and **UI engineering** teams to ensure seamless integration
- Create and adjust **UI materials** and **shaders** to improve visual quality
- Manage and optimize **UI textures** and graphic assets
- Diagnose and fix problems related to **UI** integration in **Blueprint** and **UMG**
- Ensure visual consistency of menus and **game navigation flow** interfaces
- Contribute to resolving technical constraints related to interface integration

#### Qualifications

**What you bring to the team**

- Excellent command of **Unreal**, including **UMG**, **Blueprint** and UI integration workflows
- Knowledge of **UI shaders** and **materials**
- Good understanding of **UI textures**, their formats, optimization and memory management
- Ability to balance visual quality and technical performance
- Technical, problem-solving mindset
- Effective collaboration with multidisciplinary teams
- Clear communication of technical constraints related to UI integration
- Ability to adapt to production needs and technical challenges

**What to send us**

- Your resume highlighting your skills
- Portfolio or projects relevant to the role

title: Watt Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Hotel Engineers are responsible for performing general maintenance work to ensure hotel maintenance quality and safety standards are achieved. Reporting to the Chief Engineer, you should possess the diverse knowledge of electrical, plumbing, steam, gas, fire & safety, and HVAC refrigeration.

Essential Duties:

  • Basic knowledge of, and experience with carpentry, plumbing, mechanical repair, painting, and HVAC systems preferred.
  • Knowledge of safety management principles; federal and state OSHA regulations.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds or more throughout the property with frequent lifting and/or carrying of objects.
  • Ability to walk, including climbing stairs, ladders, stand to a significant degree, kneel, reach, bend, handle machinery, lift, feel, talk, hear, and see.

Specific requirements of the role:

  • Maintain and repair plumbing and electrical systems, including replacing worn or defective parts, switches, and fuses.
  • Ensure upkeep of all fixtures and equipment according to preventative maintenance schedule and record such maintenance in logbook.
  • Respond to life safety issues including fire alarms, smoke detectors, door locking systems, etc.
  • Replace or repair TVs, door locks, plumbing fixtures, IT systems & programs, etc.
  • PM guest rooms on a daily basis and respond to guest requests during the shift.
  • Complete projects as directed to include painting rooms & public spaces.
  • Ensure cleanliness of public areas, internal areas, storage areas, and parking lot.
  • Assist other departments with moving furniture and unloading and storing supplies.
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

title: Incident Response Analyst
description:
Position Summary:

The Incident Response (IR) Analyst is responsible for monitoring security alerts and events of a critical nature to identify, contain and remediate security incidents across various services impacting the company’s customers. The IR Analysts support the SOC team through the management and administration of security and monitoring tools.

Essential Duties:

  • Thoroughly investigate and triage suspicious/malicious activity and escalate or closes events, as applicable utilizing the SIEM and other relevant 3rd party (approved) tools.
  • Perform Malware analysis through sandboxes, OSINT, and other resources.
  • Develop operational procedures to implement and continually improve the incident response processes.
  • Monitor security alerts within the tech stack, and investigate any potential security incidents.
  • Monitors incoming event queues for potential security incidents according to established operational procedures.
  • Analyze the alerts received to classify and assess the impact, managing high priority incidents, including communication to the business, facilitating root cause analysis and resolution.
  • Perform cyber security investigations as part of the incident analysis.
  • Ability to summarize and communicate technical data for non-technical audiences.
  • Coordinate with other departments the remediation tasks to be performed and escalate unresolved incidents.
  • Responsible for researching, performing risk analysis, and security audits.
  • Provide technical and incident response support.
  • Identify and investigate potential computer and network intrusions.
  • Perform post-mortem analysis to identify root causes and design controls or measures to prevent future incidents.
  • Identify, interpret, and report security vulnerabilities on systems and networks.
  • Write comprehensive investigation reports capturing investigation details and root cause analysis aligned knowledge of modern Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) for internal/customer purposes.
  • Establish and maintain communication during Incident Response, written and/or via phone.
  • Perform research on emerging threat sources/vulnerabilities.
  • Develop protection strategies.
  • Initiate and aid facilitation of Incident call bridge with the appropriate members (internal/customer resources). This includes summarizing activity, providing next steps or recommendations.
  • Create or collaborate content production for security awareness (both internal and external) including for Trapp Technology – ArmorPoint social media platforms.
  • Participates in Trapp Technology - ArmorPoint internal meetings and required trainings.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of an organization.
  • Maintains a professional image and demonstrates an understanding of and follows all Trapp Technology – ArmorPoint Policies and Procedures.
  • Between incidents, independent research and self-study to stay up-to-date on new technologies, security trends, and the overall threat landscape.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Corporate Compliance Specialist (85391)
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Primary responsibilities of this position are to control and maintain the Integrated Management Systems (IMS) and Quality Management Systems (QMS) processes utilizing the various modules in the Compliant Pro software system. Also checking to ensure users are following up on their requirements and assisting users with the process. Manage and schedule the auditing processes and perform internal audits as a lead auditor; ensure follow ups are being done for the corrective action process.

Assist the Technical Director with Management Review coordination for annual meeting.

Assist the Technical Director in assigned administrative duties.

This position reports to and works under the general direction of the Technical Director.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (List in order of importance the essential functions of the job. Describe what must be accomplished, not how it must be done; include supervision or management responsibilities, quality and quantity standards, physical, mental and perceptual functions of the job.)

  • Control and administration of all IMS documentation by maintaining integrity and consistency of Document and Data Control and following up on responsibilities of others through the data maintenance function of the CompliantPro software system.
  • Ensures compliance with the ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standards and administration and maintenance of the company’s Quality Management System document control system Compliant Pro.
  • Administer and schedule Internal Audits. This includes all audits for our IMS (quality and environmental and health & safety – for Lintec Certification). This entails working with the ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 representatives to create the audit plan and schedule for each area. Ensure that we have enough auditors to perform the various audits, train or arrange training in specific disciplines needed. Assess all audit reports for effectiveness and provide feedback to lead auditors including opportunities for improvement.
  • Manage the Integrated Systems documentation by maintaining integrity and consistency of Document and Data Control. This entails remote and on-site auditing of the process and taking action where needed.
  • Oversee all Compliant Pro module activity and follow up on issues that may arise. This may include electronic reminders, on-line training, and one-on-one or group training.
  • Keep current on ISO changes and incorporate into our management systems.
  • Conduct training of the Compliant Pro Software for all new employees.
  • Act as document control administrator and follow up on responsibilities of others through the data maintenance function of the Compliant Pro software system, and review and approve all systems documentation.
  • Perform Internal Audits as Lead Auditor and complete all necessary paperwork and follow up activities. Participate in supplier audits and customer on-site audits as requested.
  • Incorporate Compliant Pro updates and new module offerings as required with IT Department.
  • Track the progress of Corrective Actions and ensure proper follow-up is being conducted by those responsible.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: N/A

  • Administration and maintenance of company’s document control system Compliant Pro.
  • Improve work processes.

  • Write procedures and work instructions that describe your work.
  • Understand the IMS policy and how it applies.
  • Participate in internal audits.
  • Participate in ongoing process improvement.
  • Participate in external and surveillance audits.
  • Directly support methods and practices of the IMS Process through personal compliance and visible support actions.
  • Support CSR activities.

DESIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and Experience:

  • Computer literacy with knowledge of common software packages (MS Office, MS Word, MS Outlook, MS Excel, MS Access, Adobe Pro. Three to five years of experience, preferably in a related field.
  • Three to five years of experience with administration of an online document control software package and system
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and interpersonal skills are required.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS: (Any travel, security, risk, hazard or related special condition.)

A knowledge of company specific requirements, and ISO 9001, ISO14001 and OHSAS 18001 standards. Previous experience with Compliant Pro preferred but not required.

TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT USED: (Examples: list different types of office equipment, software, mainframe computer, PC, etc.)

PC, multiple software packages, standard and nonstandard.

description:

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

#### Job Description

As Monetization Director, the incumbent will be responsible for defining a long-term monetization strategy which respects the core values of the game and creates an optimal player experience.

They will collaborate with the production teams to prioritize monetization opportunities based on key performance indicators.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

title: NOC Med Aide- Full time At PLC @ Roseburg
description:
The Universal Caregiver / Medication Aide is a pivotal member of our Assisted Living and Residential Care Communities. This role involves more direct interaction with residents than any other position. Universal Caregivers / Med Aides are responsible for consistently providing detailed information about resident status, needs, and issues to ensure appropriate actions are taken. They must be vigilant in observing changes in residents’ health, attitudes, and needs, and effectively communicate these observations. Adaptability is crucial, as Universal Caregivers / Med Aides must respond to the evolving needs of both the facility and its residents. By delivering essential care, they help residents achieve and maintain their highest level of independence.

About Our Team – What we do for YOU

Our team is focused on being servant leaders to our residents, employees, and communities. We work to enhance the lives of those we serve. We want to ensure that our employees feel welcomed, prepared, and excited to care for our residents every time they are at work. Our benefits include:

  • Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and PTO for full time employees
  • Continuing education and career development opportunities
  • Generous employee referral program offering bonus and wage increase opportunities
  • ALL training is available for ALL applicants – NO experience necessary

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist residents with activities of daily living, including bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, transferring, and getting to and from activities and meals according to the individual service plan in a compassionate and attentive manner.
  • Medication setup and administration, when needed, after training.
  • Update resident records in a timely manner in accordance with company policy and procedures.
  • Report any changes in resident’s physical condition and/or behavior and observe/report the health and emotional condition of each resident. Promptly report all changes to supervisor.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and orderly environment for the residents by:
    • Performing general housekeeping and deep cleaning as required
    • Following cleaning schedules for resident laundry, bedrooms, dining area, living space, bathrooms, kitchens, and other areas.
    • Cleaning up following all meals, including cleaning dishes, wiping down tables, chairs and sweeping/vacuuming floors to clear any food.
    • Reporting and documenting any safety issues or concerns and addressing if/when appropriate.
    • Collecting garbage from resident rooms each shift. Immediately removing incontinent supplies that are wet or soiled. Removing garbage from the kitchen & laundry room one time per shift. Taking garbage to the dumpster as needed and at least one time per shift.
  • Prepare and cook food as required by following posted menus. Assist with serving all meals by bringing residents into the dining room and giving them any assistance, as needed, with their meals. Serve drinks and food to the residents.
  • Assist with daily scheduled activities by setting up per the administrator’s direction, engaging with the residents, and documenting resident participation.
  • Attend all staff trainings and in-service meetings as required.
  • Additional duties as assigned by Executive Director or team lead.

Professional Expectations

  • Present oneself in an orderly manner. Be dependable and punctual.
  • Willingness to adapt to the changing demands of this position.
  • Be helpful and polite to residents, understand their needs and respect their privacy and personal property.
  • Maintain confidentiality of all residents, employees, and the organization.
  • Have a professional and friendly demeanor when interacting with all families, guests, and loved ones either in person or on the phone.
  • Keep your areas of responsibility clean, neat, and organized.
  • Cooperate with and be polite to all staff members. Focus on teamwork!
  • Working knowledge of Assisted Living and Residential Care philosophy along with Resident’s Rights
  • Understand Senior Housing Managers Code of Conduct and Employee Handbook.

Physical Demands

  • Frequent standing and walking; occasional sitting, stooping, kneeling, crouching or crawling and working in confined spaces
  • Lift and/or move residents weighing more than 100 pounds with appropriate assistance or equipment
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Legal Requirements

Employees in this position must successfully pass all governmental and corporate required background investigations, such as, but not limited to, state required criminal history clearance investigations.

The Planner/Grant Writer researches funding opportunities and provides that information to the appropriate Tribal staff; maintains a database of grants, NOFA cycles, and grant reporting cycles.



DUTIES:

  • Work with management staff in development of grant applications, including advising and coordinating the completion of high-quality grant proposals narratives, applications and supporting documents.
  • Coordinate grant-writing activities for, and between Tribal programs. This includes locating funding sources, preparing or assisting with preparation and submission of grant applications, and budget preparation. Also includes providing technical assistance and final review of grant applications submitted by Program staff.
  • Collect, assembles, and analyzes data and prepares appropriate reports as required within the individual grant funding projects.
  • Identify problems; participate in Tribal meetings to identity funding sources for innovative new programs that will improve economic and living standards for the Siletz Tribe and its members.
  • Develops and maintains an annual grants proposal calendar.
  • Monitors, coordinates, and follows up on the progress of submitted proposals and awards.
  • Conducts prospect research to identify, cultivate and solicit new grants.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Wiodący Inżynier ds. Elektrycznego Wyposażenia Wsparcia Naziemnego Satelitów (EGSE) m/k
description:
Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy doświadczonego inżyniera, który obejmie odpowiedzialność za rozwój obszaru EGSE (Electrical Ground Support Equipment), zajmującego się projektowaniem, budową, integracją, uruchamianiem i utrzymaniem systemów oraz stanowisk testowych wykorzystywanych podczas integracji, testów i walidacji satelitów oraz systemów kosmicznych.

Rola łączy kompetencje techniczne, systemowe i organizacyjne. Szukamy osoby, która potrafi przełożyć wymagania projektowe na działające rozwiązania sprzętowe i programowe, wyznaczać kierunek rozwoju infrastruktury testowej oraz skutecznie koordynować prace zespołu odpowiedzialnego za rozwój środowisk testowych dla zaawansowanych systemów kosmicznych.

Zakres odpowiedzialności

  • koordynacja prac zespołu odpowiedzialnego za rozwój i utrzymanie systemów EGSE,

  • definiowanie architektury oraz wymagań dla systemów i stanowisk wspierających integrację oraz testowanie satelitów,

  • nadzór nad projektowaniem, budową, integracją i uruchamianiem sprzętu oraz oprogramowania EGSE,

  • zapewnienie gotowości infrastruktury testowej do kampanii integracyjnych, funkcjonalnych i środowiskowych,

  • współpraca z zespołami System Engineering, Electronics, Software, Mechanical Design oraz AIT,

  • wsparcie procesu definiowania wymagań, planowania testów oraz działań weryfikacyjnych,

  • analiza i rozwiązywanie problemów technicznych pojawiających się podczas integracji i testów systemów,

  • rozwój standardów, procesów oraz dobrych praktyk związanych z projektowaniem, eksploatacją i utrzymaniem środowisk EGSE,

  • udział w przeglądach technicznych oraz ocenie ryzyk projektowych,

  • planowanie prac zespołu oraz wspieranie rozwoju kompetencji inżynierów.

Oczekujemy

  • wykształcenia wyższego technicznego (elektronika, elektrotechnika, automatyka, mechatronika, telekomunikacja, lotnictwo i kosmonautyka lub kierunki pokrewne),

  • doświadczenia w projektowaniu, integracji, uruchamianiu lub utrzymaniu złożonych systemów testowych,

  • praktycznej znajomości elektroniki, systemów pomiarowych oraz aparatury laboratoryjnej,

  • doświadczenia w tworzeniu lub eksploatacji infrastruktury wykorzystywanej do testowania systemów technicznych,

  • umiejętności czytania dokumentacji technicznej oraz schematów elektrycznych,

  • doświadczenia w prowadzeniu projektów technicznych lub koordynacji pracy zespołu inżynierskiego,

  • umiejętności pracy na styku wielu dyscyplin technicznych,

  • znajomości języka angielskiego umożliwiającej pracę w międzynarodowych projektach.

Mile widziane

  • doświadczenie w branży kosmicznej, lotniczej, obronnej lub innych sektorach wysokich technologii,

  • znajomość procesów AIT (Assembly, Integration & Testing) oraz Verification & Validation,

  • doświadczenie związane z integracją satelitów lub systemów o podwyższonej krytyczności,

  • uprawnienia SEP,

  • doświadczenie w pracy zgodnie z wymaganiami jakościowymi charakterystycznymi dla sektorów regulated industries.

Dlaczego warto?

Będziesz odpowiadać za rozwój infrastruktury wykorzystywanej do integracji, weryfikacji i kwalifikacji satelitów realizowanych w ramach najważniejszych programów kosmicznych prowadzonych przez Creotech. To rola dla inżyniera, który chce mieć realny wpływ na sposób testowania systemów trafiających na orbitę, budować nowoczesne środowiska testowe oraz rozwijać kompetencje EGSE w jednej z wiodących firm sektora kosmicznego w Europie Środkowo-Wschodniej.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Salary: $1150 per day

Senior Project Manager
Day Rate Contract
$1150 per day
Immediate Start
Parramatta Location
Hybrid work arrangement

Applicants must already be permanently based in Sydney. Applicants must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident.
Applications not meeting these requirements cannot be considered.

About Your New Company

West Recruitment is partnering with a major organisation within the critical infrastructure sector as it undertakes a significant period of growth moving from design phase into implementation across multiple programs of work.

With significant investment underway, the organisation is delivering a complex, multi-year technology transformation program spanning infrastructure, cyber security, data, enterprise systems and operational technology.

About Your New Role

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of technology projects, working across business, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations and external delivery partners.

This is a greenfield, fast-paced environment. You will manage projects from initial business case development through to implementation and operational handover. Success will require someone who can operate independently, bring structure to ambiguity and confidently hold vendors accountable for delivery commitments.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Manage the full project lifecycle, from business case development and initiation through to planning, delivery, testing, implementation and closure.
  • Develop and review Statements of Work (SOWs), working closely with vendors, procurement, legal and commercial teams.
  • Manage external vendors, challenging missed commitments, resolving delivery issues and ensuring contractual obligations are met.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, including critical paths, dependencies and delivery milestones.
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones and acceptance criteria.
  • Identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies across multiple projects and the wider technology program.
  • Coordinate technical and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are appropriately designed, tested and transitioned into operations.
  • Manage project budgets, forecasts, financial commitments and commercial change.
  • Establish effective project governance, reporting and delivery controls in an evolving environment.
  • Provide clear, concise reporting to senior stakeholders, highlighting delivery progress, risks and decisions required.
About You

You are a full lifecycle, end-to-end project manager. You can work in a challenging, fast-paced, lean environment. You can demonstrate clear examples of successfully managing full lifecycle delivery.

You will bring:
  • Demonstrable experience managing complex technology projects. across the full lifecycle.
  • Previous roles in critical infrastructure, enterprise asset management, energy, utilities, construction, engineering or other regulated industries
  • Seasoned in managing business cases, initiation, planning, vendor engagement, implementation and closure.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong relationship skills. You can manage internal and external relationships.
  • Confidence challenging multiple vendors, managing performance and holding stakeholders accountable for agreed deliverables.
  • Experience developing Statements of Work and working with procurement, legal and commercial teams.
  • Experience managing project budgets, risks, issues, change control and governance.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and interdependencies across multiple technology workstreams.
What's in it for You?
  • Opportunity to contribute to a significant greenfield technology transformation.
  • Broad exposure to complex technology initiatives and senior stakeholders.
  • Genuine autonomy to influence requirements, delivery approaches and business outcomes.
  • Join an organisation investing heavily in its technology and operational capabilities.
Please apply to samking@westrecruitment.com.au

title: Guest Experience Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for supporting the resort operation in the role of Manager on Duty for driving Owner and Guest Relations at the resort, and for analyzing key metrics to help improve overall guest satisfaction. Monitors daily guest feedback results and identifies trends in customer experiences as evidenced within internal and external survey data, guest correspondence, and direct customer interaction. Monitors daily guest feedback results and identifies trends in customer experiences as evidenced within internal and external survey data, guest correspondence, and direct customer interaction. Communicates trends in data to resort leaders. Engages all departments in resort operations to ensure plans and actions are in place and current in order to meet the needs and expectations of Owners and Guests. Acts as the “Service Champion” for the resort and seeks out opportunities to enhance the guest experience in all areas of the resort.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 1 year experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Guest Relations Functions

• Manages the Guest Relations function and partners with GM, Leadership team and managers to address, respond and resolve all guest issues while guests are still in-house.

• Supports operations of resort by managing owner and guest relations, and analyzes key metrics to help improve overall guest satisfaction.

• Assists the GM & Director of Operations in resolving and responding to guest issues received through correspondence or submitted through Owner Services, the Guest Satisfaction Survey, the Customer Relations and Communications group or the Guest Relations group.

• Follows-up with guests who expressed a concern/issue to ensure complete satisfaction; composes response letters and tracks in the appropriate system(s).

• Performs daily resort inspections to include a combination of common areas, amenities, outlets, and guest units. Documents the condition of these areas and shares with appropriate leadership.

• Coordinates Manager on Duty efforts for the entire week ensuring the resort has proper coverage on all shifts throughout the week.

Leading Efforts to Reduce Guest Issues

• Monitors daily guest feedback results and identifies trends in customer experiences as evidenced within internal and external survey data, guest correspondence, and direct customer interaction.

• Communicates trends in data to resort leaders.

• Develops and maintains action plans for addressing trends in guest/customer relations issues and assists in monitoring the progress of various departments.

• Actively participates in resort initiatives to reduce guest “problems” and drives improved problem resolution.

• Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.

• Reviews all Guest Compensation awarded and works to mitigate financial exposure to the COA and the organization.

• Engages all departments in resort operations to ensure plans and actions are in place and current in order to meet the needs and expectations of Owners and Guests.

Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service

• Improves service by communicating with and assisting associates to understand guest needs, and by providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Acts as the “Service Champion” for the resort and seeks out opportunities to enhance the guest experience in all areas of the resort.

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service, and creates a positive atmosphere.

• Strives to improve service performance in all departments.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches others to improve their knowledge or skills.

• Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.

• Assists in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members as needed.

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Supervises and manages select employees.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position and monitors progress.

• Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.

• Facilitates various training activities such as Service Excellence, ADA, New Hire Orientation, etc.

Additional Responsibilities

• Develops the resort’s Pre-arrival call process consistent with the company’s expectations

• Manages the Pre-arrival process on an ongoing basis.

• Performs special projects as designated by the General Manager and/or Director of Operations.

• Reviews all planned projects to determine the potential impact of a project to the guest experience and develops plans to mitigate unfavorable encounters for guests resulting from the work.

• Informs and/or updates executives, peers and subordinates on relevant guest relations information in a timely manner.

• Identifies and analyzes guest relations challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.

title: Domestics Operations Agent
description:
Domestic Operations Agent

Job Type Location Salary Range
Full-Time | On-Site Houston, TX $17.50 - $21.50 per hour

Job Summary

The Domestic Operations Agent is responsible for moving freight across the U.S. by routing and tracking domestic air, ground, LTL, and FTL shipments, pricing loads, negotiating rates with carriers and partners, and spotting service problems before they reach the customer.

This role supports the operations team, ensuring shipments are handled accurately and in line with standard operating procedures, vendor charges are audited for accuracy, and service issues are communicated to management quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Move Freight

  • Coordinate domestic freight forwarding, including shipment alerts and routing through carrier portals and other online tools.

  • Follow standard operating procedures and keep every shipment record accurate in our transportation software.

  • Follow up on each shipment, collecting pieces, weights and dimensions from agents and updating the system.

Price & Quote

  • Quote domestic air, ground, LTL and FTL freight.

  • Negotiate with carriers and partners to secure special rates and spot quotes.

  • Obtain vendor charges and audit them for accuracy and legitimacy.

Protect service

  • Recognize actual and potential service failures early.

  • Communicate issues clearly and promptly to management so they can be resolved before they affect the customer.

Qualifications & Skills

Required

  • At least 1 year of domestic operations or freight forwarding experience (1-3 years preferred).

  • Strong knowledge of North American geography.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel, including formulas and charts.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Sound math skills: adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing in all units of measure, using whole numbers, fractions and decimals.

  • Strong negotiation, problem-solving and decision-making skills.

Preferred

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, logistics, international trade or a related field.

  • Experience in the transportation or logistics industry.

  • Experience with transportation management systems such as SAP or CargoWise.

  • Experience with Magaya WMS.

Skills & Competencies

Competency

What it looks like on the job

Customer service

Respond quickly and professionally to internal and external customers.

Attention to detail

Enter accurate shipment data and catch errors in vendor charges.

Organization

Juggle many shipments and deadlines without dropping follow-ups.

Communication

Write and speak clearly to carriers, drivers, warehouse, customers, and management.

Negotiation

Secure special rates and spot quotes from carriers and partners.

Problem solving

Spot service failures early and propose fixes within a team.

Teamwork

Cooperate with and respect colleagues, and cover for them when absent.

Work Schedule

Job Description Summary

The AI Platforms Product Manager is responsible for the strategy, governance, service delivery, and enterprise adoption of Microsoft Copilot Studio and related agent capabilities. This role defines how agentic AI capabilities are managed across the organization while balancing innovation and user experience with security, compliance, cost, and operational requirements.

Job Description

The Product Manager serves as the primary owner and subject-matter expert for Copilot Studio, translating rapidly evolving Microsoft AI capabilities into an enterprise product strategy and roadmap. The role partners closely with Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and other business teams to establish a sustainable enterprise agent ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Copilot Studio product strategy, roadmap, service model, and lifecycle from capability evaluation through enterprise rollout and ongoing support.
  • Evaluate new Copilot Studio, Microsoft Copilot, and agent capabilities for business value, enterprise readiness, governance requirements, and service impact.
  • Define success measures for adoption, service health, governance, user experience, and responsible AI consumption.
  • Define governance and operating models for emerging capabilities such as autonomous agents, agent identities, multi-agent solutions, and enterprise agent discovery.
  • Identify opportunities to automate Copilot Studio administration, monitoring, provisioning, reporting, and governance processes.
  • Develop scalable enablement programs for agent makers, including guidance, training, playbooks, reusable development patterns, and technical documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, including agent development, knowledge sources, tools/connectors, authentication, sharing, publishing, and enterprise governance.
  • Experience developing or managing governance frameworks for enterprise generative AI or agent-based solutions.
  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem and its relationship to Copilot Studio, including environments, Dataverse, data policies, connectors, solutions, and application lifecycle management.
  • Experience evaluating AI licensing, consumption, capacity, and cost models and translating them into enterprise service decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technology initiatives and influence outcomes without direct organizational authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, APIs, service principals, Entra identity concepts, or other technologies commonly integrated with Copilot Studio.
  • Experience developing automated governance, administration, operational reporting, or monitoring solutions.
  • Experience supporting enterprise technology services within a large, highly governed organization.

This role will help shape the organization's longer-term enterprise agent strategy, evolving from Copilot Studio product ownership into broader leadership across agent governance and lifecycle management. The Social Videographer is a hands-on creative role focused. The role is focused on social-first video capture for Hourglass Cosmetics. At its core, this person is a strong videographer, with photography and editing capabilities as a nice-to-have. They have a refined visual eye and a strong understanding of how to translate creative concepts into compelling, elevated content for social.

This role will focus on event reels, key brand moments and social-first product storytelling, bringing creative concepts to life through thoughtful, visually compelling video. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable creating elevated camera and lighting setup for a controlled studio shoot and moving quickly to capture dynamic event videography.

You will work closely to execute creative concepts from brief through capture and post-production, while also responding to social briefs with strong visual solutions and bringing your own creative point of view to the work.

Video editing and photography experience are a bonus, particularly for event and behind-the-scenes capture, but video capture is the primary focus of the role.

You will work closely with the Social Media, Influencer and Brand Marketing teams. We are looking for someone who is creative, collaborative and eager to contribute ideas, receptive to feedback and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own social-first video capture across product storytelling, event reels and key brand moments.

  • Stay close to social, culture and emerging visual behaviors, identifying creative opportunities that feel relevant while remaining distinctly Hourglass.
  • Help build efficient, repeatable capture and editing workflows that allow the team to respond to the pace of social.

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF:

  • You are CREATIVE: a videographer first with a strong visual eye and a distinct point of view.
  • You are SOCIAL-NATIVE: you understand how people consume content today and instinctively know what will feel natural and compelling on social.
  • You are CONCEPTUAL: you can take a creative idea and translate it into thoughtful, visually interesting video.
  • You are DETAIL ORIENTED: you care about composition, lighting, movement, framing and the small details that elevate a piece of content.
  • You are AGILE: you can move between a planned product shoot, an in-store moment and a fast-moving event without losing creative intention.
  • You are a strong COMMUNICATOR: curious, proactive and comfortable contributing ideas while taking direction.
  • You are COLLABORATIVE: receptive to feedback and able to work closely with creative and marketing partners.
  • You are RESOURCEFUL: comfortable working with professional camera equipment and lighting as well as an iPhone when the moment calls for it.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Photography experience is a plus, particularly for event, BTS and social capture.
  • Ability to travel for shoots, events and key brand moments as needed.
  • Must be able to work from Corporate Office at least 60% of the time.

title: Research Associate in Ubiquitin Signalling
description:
**Please upload a single PDF document containing your CV and cover letter.**

This is a fantastic opportunity for a postdoctoral Research Associate, with a background in protein biochemistry, molecular biology or molecular recognition, to work within the Kulathu group under the supervision of Professor Yogesh Kulathu. The post holder will be part of the Kulathu group, which is based at the University of Manchester. How do different ubiquitin signals direct different cellular outcomes? We investigate how ubiquitin and ubiquitin-like signalling coordinate cellular quality control, combining innovative tools with biochemical, structural and cellular approaches.

The candidate will support the aims of a BBSRC funded research programme to develop precision tools to dissect ubiquitin signalling. This innovative project will study how polyubiquitin chains of different linkages encode cellular signals. You will develop a nanobody toolkit to recognise these chains and enable new experiments in ubiquitin biology. Your work will connect nanobody selection and engineering with protein biochemistry, quantitative binding assays and cellular applications. Working with colleagues in structural biology, proteomics and cell biology, you will investigate molecular recognition and develop approaches to detect, visualise and interrogate ubiquitin signalling. There will be scope to shape the toolkit’s applications, pursue the biological questions it opens up and create reagents of lasting value to the research community.

This position offers an ideal opportunity for an enthusiastic, well-motivated individual with interest in tool and methodology development to work as part of a sociable multi-disciplinary team consisting of biochemists, structural biologists, cell biologists and proteomics researchers. We offer scientific ownership and mentoring tailored to your development towards independence. Inclusion, empathy and integrity underpin our culture. We welcome motivated and creative researchers who enjoy challenging problems and want to create tools that enable discovery across a field. The ideal candidate will have excellent experimental design, quantitative analysis and problem-solving skills, and will be able to work with minimal supervision. A rigorous and collaborative approach to research is essential for the position. Experience of protein biochemistry or molecular biology is required, together with a clear interest in ubiquitin signalling. Experience with protein engineering, studying protein-protein interactions or cellular imaging would be advantageous.

**What you will get in return:**

- Fantastic market leading Pension scheme
- Excellent employee health and wellbeing services including an Employee Assistance Programme
- Exceptional starting annual leave entitlement, plus bank holidays
- Additional paid closure over the Christmas period
- Local and national discounts at a range of major retailers

As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applicants from all sections of the community regardless of age, sex, gender (or gender identity), ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation and transgender status. All appointments are made on merit.

Hybrid working arrangements may be considered.

title: Kierownik zakładu cukierniczego (k/m/x)
description:
Putka Sp. z o.o. to marka, która od pokoleń towarzyszy Polakom przy stole. Jesteśmy jedną z największych sieci piekarniczo-cukierniczych w kraju, łączącą silną tradycję z nowoczesnym podejściem do produkcji, jakości i rozwoju biznesu.

Nasza organizacja jest dziś na etapie dalszego wzmacniania efektywności operacyjnej oraz przygotowań do kolejnych wyzwań rozwojowych. Właśnie dlatego szukamy osoby na stanowisko Kierownika/czki Zakładu Cukierniczego, która obejmie odpowiedzialność za całość funkcjonowania zakładu cukierniczego w Warszawie, w dzielnicy Wesoła.

To rola gospodarza / gospodyni zakładu. Będziesz odpowiadać nie tylko za produkcję, ale za miejsce na putkowej mapie: technologię, magazyn surowców, dział gospodarczy, zespół biurowy oraz bezpieczeństwo każdego, kto wykonuje pracę na terenie zakładu w Wesołej. Kluczowym zadaniem będzie zapewnienie sprawnego, codziennego funkcjonowania zakładu: realizacja planu produkcyjnego, utrzymanie standardów jakościowych, porządek w organizacji pracy oraz zarządzanie zespołem, który bierze odpowiedzialność za wynik swojej pracy.

Jeśli cenisz sobie współpracę z firmą, która docenia tradycję, ale jednocześnie konsekwentnie rozwija swoje procesy i standardy zarządzania, dołącz do naszego zespołu.

Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • Zarządzanie całością zakładu cukierniczego w warszawskiej Wesołej: produkcja, technologia, dział gospodarczy, magazyn surowców oraz zespół biurowy zakładu.

  • Organizacja produkcji i obsady zmian oraz nadzór nad realizacją planu produkcyjnego, celów jakościowych oraz terminowości.

  • Nadzór nad pracą technologów: dyscyplina technologiczna, zgodność z recepturami oraz standardy produktu, a także udział we wdrażaniu nowych wyrobów.

  • Nadzór nad gospodarką magazynową surowców: dostępność, rotacja, inwentaryzacje oraz ograniczanie strat.

  • Nadzór nad działem gospodarczym oraz utrzymaniem obiektu w stanie zgodnym z wymaganiami sanitarnymi i technicznymi.

  • Zapewnienie zgodności funkcjonowania zakładu z obowiązującymi wymaganiami jakościowymi, sanitarnymi oraz bezpieczeństwa żywności.

  • Odpowiedzialność za bezpieczeństwo i higienę pracy wszystkich osób wykonujących pracę na terenie zakładu, w tym tych, które podlegają działom centralnym.

  • Zarządzanie zespołem zakładu, w tym kierownikami i specjalistami: wyznaczanie zadań, rozliczanie wyników, rozwój kompetencji oraz budowanie kultury odpowiedzialności za wynik.

  • Bieżąca współpraca z działami centralnymi: jakością, utrzymaniem ruchu, logistyką, zakupami oraz hr.

  • Monitorowanie wskaźników operacyjnych zakładu (wydajność, straty, terminowość, absencja) oraz podejmowanie działań korygujących.

  • Zgłaszanie i opiniowanie potrzeb zakładu w zakresie zmian organizacyjnych, technologicznych oraz remontowych.

Nasze wymagania:

  • Wykształcenie wyższe.

  • 5-7 lat doświadczenia zawodowego w branży spożywczej, w tym co najmniej 3 lata w samodzielnym kierowaniu zakładem lub co najmniej jednym dużym wydziałem produkcyjnym.

  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu zespołem złożonym z różnych funkcji, nie tylko produkcyjnych, na przykład technologii, magazynu czy obsługi obiektu.

  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu produkcją w środowisku o wysokich wymaganiach jakościowych i organizacyjnych, mile widziane w obszarze cukierni, piekarni albo produkcji świeżej.

  • Praktyczna znajomość procesów produkcyjnych, planowania pracy oraz organizacji zmian.

  • Dobra znajomość standardów jakości, bezpieczeństwa żywności, przepisów bhp oraz wymagań sanitarnych dotyczących zakładów produkcyjnych.

  • Umiejętność łączenia spojrzenia na cały zakład z wysoką sprawczością operacyjną oraz skutecznym egzekwowaniem ustaleń, także wobec osób podlegających innym przełożonym.

  • Rozwinięte kompetencje organizacyjne, analityczne oraz przywódcze.

  • Samodzielność, odpowiedzialność oraz umiejętność podejmowania decyzji w dynamicznym środowisku produkcyjnym.

Mile widziane:

  • Doświadczenie w roli gospodarza obiektu produkcyjnego, z odpowiedzialnością za jego stan techniczny oraz sanitarny.

  • Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu projektów usprawniających albo reorganizacyjnych w zakładzie produkcyjnym.

  • Znajomość narzędzi lean management / continuous improvement.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy w zakładzie o produkcji wielozmianowej.

To oferujemy:

  • Pracę w firmie, która łączy tradycję z nowoczesnym podejściem do zarządzania i rozwoju biznesu.

  • Atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie i pakiet benefitów.

  • Realny wpływ na organizację pracy całego zakładu oraz na standardy, według których pracuje zespół.

  • Samodzielne stanowisko z szerokim, jasno określonym zakresem odpowiedzialności oraz ze wsparciem działów centralnych.

title: Parts Counter
description:
As a Parts Counter for Power Motive Corporation, you will play a vital role in our parts departments overall success. The Parts Counter is responsible for assisting customers and our service technicians in identifying, ordering, and purchasing the correct parts for heavy equipment, while maintaining accurate inventory and providing excellent customer service. This role is essential for keeping the service department running smoothly, ensuring parts availability, and maximizing customer satisfaction. It blends retail sales, technical support, and inventory control, making it a critical operational position in our heavy equipment dealership.

Essential Functions:

  • Assist customers in locating and purchasing parts for their machine needs.
  • Process orders and quote requests from customers, PSSR’s and Service Technicians. Perform daily invoicing for shipped parts as well as submit purchase orders for backordered parts.
  • If need be, expedite backordered parts with their respective vendor or alternate supplier on a as needed basis.
  • Processes all parts returns- both shop returns and customer returns. Files all claims with vendors.
  • Helps receiving on an as need basis. Must be able to lift up to 100 lbs.
  • Attends training classes to stay current on parts programs.

iSpot to największy w Polsce Reseller oraz Autoryzowany Serwis produktów Apple. Czy wiesz, że jako jedyni w Polsce posiadamy status Apple Premium Partnera? Nasze rozwiązania są kompleksowo wdrażanie w jednostkach samorządu terytorialnego: miastach i jednostkach podległych, powiatach, urzędach marszałkowskich i placówkach oświatowych. Wspieramy także przedsiębiorstwa . poprzez systemy finansowe, kadrowo-płacowe a także z zakresu logistyki i produkcji.

  • Wysoki poziom zaangażowania i odpowiedzialności za powierzone zadania.

  • Język angielski pozwalający na swobodne korzystanie z dokumentacji technicznej.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z produktami wykorzystującymi AI/ML lub LLM.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami no-code/low-code.

Zakres obowiązków

  • Analiza potrzeb klientów i interesariuszy oraz przekładanie ich na wymagania biznesowe i funkcjonalne.

  • Definiowanie wymagań i kryteriów akceptacji we współpracy z działami wdrożeniowymi oraz klientami.

  • Współpraca z zespołami programistycznymi przy planowaniu i realizacji zadań.

  • Weryfikacja realizacji wymagań i odbiór wykonanych funkcjonalności na podstawie zdefiniowanych kryteriów akceptacji.

  • Prowadzenie analiz biznesowych w różnych obszarach na potrzeby rozwoju istniejących oraz tworzenia nowych produktów.

  • Współpraca z różnymi obszarami organizacji w celu zdobywania wiedzy potrzebnej do analizy i rozwoju produktów.


Co oferujemy:

💼 Stabilność i elastyczność: umowa o pracę, świadczenia urlopowe (tzw. "Wczasy pod gruszą"), ergonomiczne stanowisko pracy i parking.

🚀 Rozwój: Szkolenia, kursy, wyjazdy na konferencje i wydarzenia branżowe, wewnętrzna akademia wiedzy, firmowa biblioteczka oraz konkursy na innowacje i inne inicjatywy z nagrodami.

🎉 Atmosfera: firmowe spotkania i wyjazdy integracyjne, pikniki firmowe, mikołajki oraz kultura dzielenia się wiedzą, wsparcie i partnerskie podejście.

description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa zlecenie: 10000 – 30000 PLN / mies. brutto
B2B: 10000 – 30000 PLN / mies. netto

Od 5 000 zł prowizji za umowę | Szkolenie od zera | Pomorskie

Kim jesteśmy:

Polentis Energy to zespół, który codziennie wygrywa. Działamy z energią, pozytywnie i z ambicją bycia najlepszymi.

Nasza misja: domy w Polsce mają być bezpieczne, niezależne i energooszczędne.

Dlatego dostarczamy rozwiązania: PV + magazyn energii + EMS.

EMS to „mózg” domu – steruje energią tak, żeby dawała klientowi kontrolę kosztów i przewidywalność.

Co zyskujesz?

  • Od 5 000 zł prowizji za każdą podpisaną umowę

  • Realne zarobki: 10 000 – 30 000 zł miesięcznie (w zależności od wyników)

  • Dodatek do auta: 2 000 zł przy realizacji celów
    Baza + przygotowane plany działania, gotowe materiały i wsparcie zespołu

  • Nauczymy Cię skutecznego systemu sprzedaży od zera – krok po kroku

  • Szkolenia sprzedażowe i rozwój osobisty prowadzi Jakub Czarnecki trener i praktyk (Master Class ICAN Institute), absolwent EY Academy of Business

Jak wygląda start?

  • Dzień 1 – rynek, produkt i system sprzedaży

  • Dzień 2 – trening rozmów + pierwsze spotkania

  • Wdrożenie 2 tygodnie z liderem – praca na realnych rozmowach, feedback, rytm

  • Pierwsze umowy podpisujesz z liderem i otrzymujesz za nie prowizję

  • Po 7 dniach możesz mieć pierwszą umowę i pierwszą prowizję – przy realizacji planu

3 rzeczy, które u nas decydują o sukcesie:

  1. Liczba spotkań – wyniki robi rytm i konsekwencja.

  2. Egzekucja planu – robisz to, co działa, dzień po dniu.

  3. Odpowiedzialność za wynik – bierzemy odpowiedzialność i dowozimy.

Etapy rekrutacji:

  1. Pierwszy sygnał - Analizujemy Twoje CV i dzwonimy na krótką rozmowę. Kilka konkretnych pytań, by sprawdzić, czy nadajemy na tych samych falach. Od momentu przesłania CV czekasz maksymalnie tydzień.

  2. Szybka analiza - Po telefonie oceniamy Twoje odpowiedzi i decydujemy, czy idziemy w to dalej. Cenimy Twój i nasz czas, więc działamy sprawnie.

  3. Dzień z zespołem - Zapraszamy Cię na spotkanie szkoleniowe. Tutaj bez owijania w bawełnę zobaczysz, co robimy i jak pracujemy. Poznasz ludzi, z którymi będziesz ramię w ramię realizować cele.

  4. Szczera decyzja - Po spotkaniu obie strony wykładają karty na stół. Decydujemy wspólnie, czy zaczynamy współpracę. Tak lub nie – prosta i uczciwa sprawa.

Kogo szukamy?

Ambitnych osób, które chcą wygrywać, rozwijać się i zarabiać duże pieniądze.

Doświadczenie w sprzedaży mile widziane, ale jeśli go nie masz, wdrożymy Cię od zera.

Zainwestujemy w Twój rozwój poprzez szkolenia sprzedaży i indywidualny mentoring.

Bezpieczeństwo. Niezależność. Wynik.
